And now, the industry is scared of the dark shadows of the past, when the underworld called the shots in Bollywood. And just like the past, this time too, the masterminds seem to be operating from foreign shores. But was Tiger Shroff the real target? Is this shootout related to incidents like the firing outside actor Salman Khan’s residence, the murder of NCP leader Baba Siddique, the shooting outside filmmaker Rohit Shetty’s residence and the reported threats to actors Ranveer Singh and Aamir Khan? In this week’s Pulse Maharashtra with Vinaya Deshpande, we take you through what we know so far and what the unanswered questions are. stories.title: Nearly 30-year-old Magnum Ego ice cream found frozen in 145-year-old Australian store
stories.summary: During a recent freezer renovation in Harrow, Victoria, a shopkeeper stumbled upon a Magnum Ego ice cream believed to be nearly 30 years old. This finding, dating back to the late 1990s, has sparked a wave of nostalgia among Australians reminiscing about their childhood indulgences. Alongside this classic treat, other forgotten snacks like chips and milk containers were also uncovered.

Jon Bon Jovi's Toms River restaurant serves diners facing food insecurity; over 80% of meals went to guests in need in early 2026

This unique restaurant model fosters a community atmosphere, inviting both paying diners and volunteers to partake in shared meals. Beyond nourishment, it connects individuals with vital resources for housing and mental health support.

stories.title: Texas grandfather wins $93,778 case against grandchildren's mother over unpaid child support
stories.summary: A Texas grandfather who gained custody of his three grandchildren after their father's death in 2017 has won a legal battle against their mother over unpaid child support and medical expenses. On October 23, a Texas appeals court upheld a $93,778 judgment against the mother, including $65,532 in medical costs. The mother had challenged the payments, arguing that the grandfather had not provided sufficient documentation to support his claims.

stories.title: Florida city opens $31 million botanical and wellness park at 209-acre Tucker Ranch preserve
stories.summary: On October 23, 2026, Tucker Ranch Holistic Health and Wellness Park along with its Botanical Garden opened its doors to the public. This remarkable transformation of a former cattle ranch spans 25.6 acres, featuring stunning botanical displays, outdoor fitness spaces, and wellness facilities initiated through a substantial investment. Its mission is to foster health, education, and outdoor engagement for both residents and visitors, with free daily access for all.

Centre to train 10,000 healthcare workers in drug de-addiction by 2029
stories.summary: India's health ministry has initiated a program to train 10,000 healthcare professionals on substance use disorders. The program aims to improve prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of addiction to substances like alcohol and opioids. In the current fiscal year, 2,000 personnel will be trained, with further increments planned over the next two years. Training will be provided through both online and offline methods across various healthcare institutions.

stories.summary: In an inspiring private fundraising gala, Ed Sheeran performed in New York, raising a remarkable $1 million to support disadvantaged children in Suffolk. Local charities will benefit from the funds, which Ipswich Town Football Club chairman Mark Ashton praised. The Lentonbrook Foundation plans to enhance its existing programs for youth in need, ensuring that the community continues to receive vital support.

stories.title: Wyoming landowner’s kitchenless guest house claim rejected by federal appeals court
stories.summary: Gary Binning confronted challenges while trying to build a guest house on his conservation-eased property, as a former Wyoming Supreme Court ruling placed restrictions on residential constructions. Despite his efforts to propose a design without a kitchen in talks with The Nature Conservancy, his idea was rejected due to its multiple residential characteristics. Ultimately, the courts dismissed the case, citing a lack of clarity and reasonable argument in Binning's claims.

stories.title: After 160 years of excavations, archaeologists find a 2,800-year-old bone flute at ancient Troy
stories.summary: For the first time in 160 years, archaeologists unearthed a bone flute at Troy, dating back approximately 2,800 years. In addition, they found a humanoid idol from the Early Bronze Age, offering new insights into the region's cultural traditions. The discoveries were announced by Turkish Minister of Culture and Tourism, Mehmet Nuri Ersoy. This time period correlates with the legendary works of Greek poet Homer.

stories.title: CDC deputy director Jennifer Shuford to exit role after midterms amid vaccine policy changes: Report
stories.summary: Jennifer Shuford, the chief medical officer of the CDC, plans to step down following the midterm elections due to shifts in the Trump administration's vaccine strategy. This new approach introduces a segmented vaccination regimen. Speculations about her exit suggest personal health concerns or differing views on vaccine messaging may have influenced her departure. The CDC and White House have yet to publicly address Shuford's upcoming exit.

Ocean Mixing Barrier Shown: Dye experiment maps slow downward transport; layered structure limits exchange
stories.summary: In a recent experiment near Martha’s Vineyard, scientists introduced rhodamine dye into the Atlantic Ocean to study its behavior. The dye spread quickly in the surface waters but demonstrated a slower descent into deeper layers. Findings showed a marked difference in mixing rates, emphasizing the complexities of ocean stratification on substance movement. This research is vital for the advancement of nutrient and pollutant transport models.

Shi asserts that the city violated state law’s requirements for prompt reviews. stories.summary: New Zealand's critically endangered southern dotterel population has risen by 52 percent following focused predator control efforts. Intensive campaigns targeting feral cats on Stewart Island have yielded immediate gains in breeding. The population grew from 105 birds in early 2025 to an estimated 160 in April 2026. Wildlife officials stress that ongoing management of feral cats is crucial for the bird's long-term survival.

California farmer triples walnut revenue by selling directly to 300 customers from a list of 10k
stories.summary: A walnut farmer in California revolutionized his sales with a targeted email marketing campaign. Reaching out to prior cherry customers, he uncovered 300 interested buyers for his walnuts. This approach resulted in his gross revenue tripling against wholesale prices, proving that even a small customer base can boost income stability. Consequently, many farmers are now embracing direct sales strategies to lessen financial uncertainties.

While the 45-room property remains empty, he survives on donated food and clothes, uses power banks to read books on his phone and relies on charity services for essentials. Neighbours have gradually accepted his presence.

stories.title: Man buys box of old medals for £25, discovers rare Captain Cook medal worth £5,000
stories.summary: A man who bought a box of 22 old medals for just £25 at a car-boot sale in West Yorkshire discovered that one was a rare 18th-century medal commemorating Captain James Cook's death in 1779. After selling the other medals for £500, he took the rare piece to an auction house, where it later fetched £5,000. The medal was purchased by the Captain Cook Memorial Museum in Whitby for a special exhibition planned for 2028.

stories.summary: Tyler Perry has listed his Beverly Hills mansion for $57 million amid plans to relocate to Puerto Rico. The estate, known for hosting Prince Harry and Meghan Markle, spans approximately 24,600 square feet. Featuring eight bedrooms and extensive amenities, it offers privacy within the exclusive Beverly Ridge Estates community. stories.summary: A Texas couple have lost their legal battle to remain on 70 acres of land they say had been in their family for decades. He cited Lal Krishna Advani's collegium system as a potential method for their selection. Oka placed strong emphasis on civil discourse as a pillar of democracy and raised alarms about environmental issues fueling rising temperatures in urban areas like Thane and Mumbai. Additionally, he recommended more efficient uses for public transport funding.

stories.summary: A father in Arizona has successfully appealed a protection order placed against him by his child's mother. The Michigan Court of Appeals reversed an earlier court decision and ordered the protection order to be canceled. This dispute arose after the mother moved to Michigan with their child, preventing scheduled parenting time. The appeals court found that the mother did not provide sufficient evidence for the protection order.

stories.summary: A Michigan appeals court has made headlines by overturning a hefty judgment against a couple who backed out of purchasing a luxury residence. This pivotal case is currently awaiting resolution in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York.

stories.title: San Francisco approves auction of $4.4 million vacant home with $340,000 in unpaid taxes and fraud
stories.summary: A luxurious mansion in San Francisco, appraised at $4.4 million, has racked up over $340,000 in unpaid property taxes, prompting the city's Board of Supervisors to initiate a public tax auction. stories.summary: Vanessa Trump has revealed that extreme fatigue was the first sign of her “very invasive” breast cancer, diagnosed six months ago. Now cancer-free after undergoing a lumpectomy and radiation treatment, she has shared details of her recovery and encouraged people to prioritise their health, schedule regular screenings and understand the importance of early detection.

stories.title: US appeals court rules 10-7 against bond hearings for immigrants detained after illegal entry
stories.summary: The US Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit has made a pivotal ruling concerning immigrant detention, involving three men who unlawfully entered the country. The court decided to overturn earlier decisions that allowed them individualized bond hearings while awaiting removal proceedings. This change stirs substantial dialogue on the potential impacts on the constitutional rights of immigrants facing detention without due process.

stories.summary: A remarkable relic from the Mughal era, the 'Yerkes-Remarque' carpet, is set to go under the hammer at Sotheby's. stories.title: 25 Arizona voters wrongly flagged by Trump administration regain voting rights days before midterms
stories.summary: Twenty-five US citizens in Arizona have regained their voting access after being wrongly flagged as possible noncitizens. stories.title: At 17, British student Max Budgen drew 1,300 flipbook pages to set a Guinness World Record
stories.summary: Max Budgen, a 17-year-old student from Petersfield, Hampshire, created a 1,300-page hand-drawn flipbook. Reaching significant milestones, such as 300 and 1,000 pages, motivated him throughout the process.

stories.title: Irish father loses wedding ring in Italian stream; 3 strangers fly to Ireland to return it
stories.summary: During a delightful family vacation in Italy, an Irish father accidentally lost his wedding ring while enjoying time with his kids. Determined to recover it, his wife enlisted the help of three local good Samaritans who tirelessly searched the river for three days. stories.summary: Scarlett Johansson and Colin Jost have purchased a co-op penthouse in Manhattan, which took seven years to sell. He pointed fingers at the administration for hampering commerce by suspending metro services and blocking roads. Traders are reportedly facing losses of around Rs 3,000 crore following previous rallies in October.

stories.title: Zendaya expands Hollywood Hills estate with another $2M home
stories.summary: Zendaya began her real estate journey with a Mediterranean-style home purchased at age 20 in San Fernando Valley. She later acquired a ranch-style estate in Encino and a luxury condo in Brooklyn Heights. Recently, Zendaya bought a mid-century modern home in Hollywood Hills, previously owned by Ashley Tisdale. She subsequently purchased a neighboring property, a fixer-upper, signaling her intent to renovate it.

stories.title: Australia expands biometric requirements for visa applicants in India from October 26
Edinburgh rejects 212MW data centre as Scottish Ministers review appeal
'Insult to India itself': Rajnath Singh attacks Kharge over 'baap' remark against PM Modi
stories.summary: Defence minister Rajnath Singh has taken a strong stand against Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge's statements about Prime Minister Modi, labeling them as disrespectful to both the leader and the nation. Singh asserted that Modi remains focused on serving citizens and undeterred by such comments. Following these remarks, a protest by the BJP's Patna Metropolitan unit was promptly organized.

stories.title: 'Gyanesh Kumar must quit': Kharge lists INDIA bloc's three key demands amid SIR row
Thick smoke emanates from North Block; six fire tenders on site
Alabama father and daughter feared arson before their $500,000 home burned down
Rahul Gandhi acquitted in 2018 defamation case over remarks on Amit Shah
stories.summary: A special MP/MLA court in Sultanpur dismissed a defamation case against Congress MP Rahul Gandhi on Monday. This case originated in 2018 due to remarks Gandhi made about Amit Shah during a rally. Vijay Mishra, a local BJP politician, filed the complaint alleging Gandhi's comments were defamatory. Rahul Gandhi appeared before the court in 2023, where he secured bail successfully.

stories.title: AI model uses face photos to estimate biological age, predict survival risk in cancer patients
stories.summary: A new AI model, FAHR-Face, estimates biological age and predicts cancer patient survival risk using facial photos. This model was trained on millions of images and showed an average error of about five years. Alongside this, another model identified high-risk cancer patients based on their appearance, highlighting significant survival differences. While results were promising in the US and Netherlands, further validation is needed in other populations.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi's convoy involved in minor accident on Purvanchal Expressway
PM Modi congratulates Brazil's Lula on re-election, says will advance Global South cooperation
Elon Musk pledges SpaceX shares to 72 million American children
Trump Claims Trade Imbalance: accuses Canada of exploiting US; says deal likely but no rush
stories.summary: Donald Trump has voiced concerns that Canada has been exploiting trade advantages over the United States for years. He asserts that talks between the nations are nearing a satisfactory agreement for the U.S. economy. Trump advocates for a sustainable deal rather than a temporary fix, criticizing Canadian tariffs and calling for transparency in trade practices. Despite the friction, he remains hopeful for a resolution to the ongoing trade conflict.

stories.title: ABBA’s Chiquitita raised over $5 million for UNICEF in 45 years; how the 1979 hit continues to protect children
stories.summary: ABBA's song Chiquitita has raised over US$5 million for UNICEF since its release in 1979. This funding supports various programs aimed at protecting vulnerable children from abuse and violence. The pledge originated during a concert at the United Nations to promote children's rights. In 2021, ABBA extended its support by pledging royalties from another song to UNICEF.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia’s Singapore plan: How Riyadh aims to protect Asian oil supplies from 2027
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia is set to store crude oil in Singapore starting in the second half of 2027. This arrangement aims to enhance energy security in the region amid supply disruptions. Singapore's Jurong Rock Caverns will provide storage facilities for Saudi crude oil supplies. The agreement will allow Saudi Aramco to bring supplies closer to key Asian markets.

stories.title: BJP files police complaint against Kharge over 'baap' remark targeting PM Modi
stories.summary: Bharatiya Janata Party has lodged a police complaint against Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge in Patna. The complaint relates to Kharge's remarks about Prime Minister Modi during an event during 139th birth anniversary Bihar's first CM, Shrikrishna Singh. Krishna Kumar Singh, a BJP worker, demands an apology from Kharge within 24 hours. The initial report was filed at Kotwali police station, then transferred to Gandhi Maidan.

stories.title: 'Gotta stop killing them to know who we're dealing with': Trump says top Iranian leaders gone
'Utilizing Iran for politics': IDF chief, Netanyahu clash over military action ahead of Israel elections - report
stories.summary: Tension brews within Israel's leadership as Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and IDF chief Eyal Zamir disagree on possible military action against Iran. This clash before elections raises eyebrows about political motives behind military strategies. Netanyahu highlights the imminent threat Iran poses and urges immediate action during Trump's administration. As the election approaches, Netanyahu faces tight competition from Gadi Eisenkot, suggesting possible political deadlock with no clear majority in view.

stories.title: 'Had enough': Thousands protest in Prague against Czech government's public media funding overhaul
stories.summary: Thousands gathered in Prague to protest government proposals affecting public television and radio funding. The planned changes would replace licence fees with state budget allocations, raising concerns about media independence. Critics argue that these measures may expose broadcasters to political pressure and reduce their financial stability. Public media employees announced plans for a strike on November 3, with a larger rally scheduled for November 15.

stories.title: Protesters dragged, knocked down: French police charges right into crowd; watch
‘Vote for Netanyahu’: Trump urges Israelis to re-elect ‘outstanding warrior’ PM
stories.summary: HHNBAhead of the crucial Israeli elections, Donald Trump has thrown his support behind Benjamin Netanyahu, underlining the critical role their alliance plays in countering Iran's threats to both nations. Trump praised Netanyahu's effectiveness as a leader throughout their joint military efforts, despite previous tensions regarding their strategies towards Iran. This endorsement marks a notable moment as it's uncommon for a sitting U.S.

stories.title: Riyadh airport partially reopens: Saudi intercepts Houthi ballistic missile, drones
stories.summary: A Saudi-led coalition reported intercepting Houthi ballistic missiles aimed at Riyadh, claiming to protect the capital. Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree described King Khalid International Airport as unsafe for travellers and staff. The airport administration designated terminals for domestic and international flights despite warnings. Additionally, attacks against Yemeni civilian sites by Saudi warplanes were claimed to be extensive. Claims made by both sides regarding missile interceptions and airstrikes remain unverified.

stories.title: Sri Lanka gives medical aid to stranded Iranian sailors
Did US officials campaign to tilt Brazil polls towards Bolsonaros?
‘Don’t test us:’ Bibi warns Iran against election disruption
Iranians fear possible return to war as US, Israeli polls approach
Obama unloads on Trump while stumping for Democrats ahead of midterms
Lula wins fourth term as Brazil president after tight runoff
Serbia’s Vucic concedes defeat as student-led movement wins parliamentary election
Raids on NE drug cartels reveal illicit deals worth Rs 270cr
EAM to UN: Lead during global crises, don’t just be a spectator
Massive fire engulfs Shiv Market near Jammu Railway Station, 35-40 shops gutted
John Stamos’ former California mansion drops from $13 million to $6.4 million after renovations
stories.summary: John Stamos’s luxurious California mansion has experienced substantial price drops since 2025. Initially, this Mediterranean-style estate in Calabasas was priced near $13 million, but after renovations by the current owners, it now stands at about $6.4 million. Stamos originally acquired the property in 1991 for $430,000 and sold it in 2001, illustrating the complexities in marketing highly personalized high-end real estate.

stories.title: Philadelphia Orchestra marks 14th China tour with $10.5m gift for global tours and new music
stories.summary: David L Cohen and Rhonda R Cohen have made an impressive commitment of $10.5 million to the Philadelphia Orchestra. This significant donation aims to fund international tours and foster cultural exchanges, while also introducing new music initiatives worldwide. Their contribution will establish the Fund for Cultural Diplomacy, enhancing the orchestra's role as a cultural ambassador, alongside launching the Artistic Innovation and Discovery Fund to spotlight underrepresented composers.

stories.title: Ahead of leaders' summit, Quad foreign ministers to meet in US
‘Creamy layer case in SC won’t hit seniority of CSE-2025 batch’
CBSE makes AI a part of formal teaching, NCERT develops module
EC refuses to give details of SIR software, cites ‘trade secrets, IPR'
stories.summary: Election Commission of India declined to share the name of the software used for identifying electoral roll errors. The request for information was made under the Right to Information Act. A social activist from Telangana sought details about the software and algorithms used in the process. The Commission stated that no new software was developed for the exercise conducted.

stories.title: Hendrie Ranch Conservation Easement: Florida approves $12.9m deal; wildlife corridor stays working
stories.summary: A 5,610-acre section of Hendrie Ranch will remain undeveloped due to a $12.9 million conservation easement. This agreement, approved by state officials, allows continued agricultural use while protecting the land from development. The ranch supports cattle, hay production, and timber harvesting alongside diverse wildlife habitats. It is part of Florida's Rural and Family Lands Protection Program to safeguard agricultural properties.

stories.title: Former CJI D Y Chandrachud was more deferential to government than needed, says Justice Kaul
stories.summary: Justice Sanjay Kishan Kaul has expressed concerns about how former Chief Justice D Y Chandrachud dealt with the government. He believes Chandrachud was too lenient during the process of judicial appointments, which raises worries about the independence of the judiciary. This could potentially undermine the separation between the courts and the government, according to Kaul.

stories.title: EPFO considers Rs 25,000cr war chest to stabilise interest payouts
stories.summary: Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation is exploring the establishment of a Rs 25,000-crore Interest Stabilisation Reserve. This reserve aims to protect members’ interest payouts from corporate bond defaults and other market fluctuations. A report suggested that the fund should be built via surplus ETF gains and will invest in government securities. Historical performance indicates that this reserve can effectively manage interest rate stability.

stories.title: Delaware couple wins HOA garage dispute as court orders removal of property violation notice
stories.summary: John and Sandra Mitchell have won a court case against their homeowners association regarding garage construction plans. They proposed a 24-by-28-foot garage with metal siding, which the board initially rejected. The court ruled that the association overstepped its authority by denying the materials without clear restrictions. The violation notice against their property was ordered to be removed from public records.

stories.title: BJP calls protest over Kharge’s ‘baap’ remark
stories.summary: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge's comment about Prime Minister Narendra Modi's father sparked widespread outrage among BJP members. Following the incident, the BJP announced nationwide protests against Kharge's remarks, labeling them indecent and offensive. Union home minister Amit Shah criticized Congress for personal attacks and blamed it on their electoral disappointments. Kharge also condemned the ongoing Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls, describing it as a threat to democracy.

stories.title: New York man challenges bank over 2005 mortgage, wins appeal in foreclosure dispute
stories.summary: A New York homeowner who took out a mortgage in 2005 has secured a reversal of a foreclosure ruling that had favoured US Bank National Association. Moses Sukljian challenged the bank's right to enforce the loan after it accused him of missing payments. On Friday, an appeals court overturned the earlier ruling, finding that the bank had failed to provide sufficient proof of its legal standing.

stories.title: Trump gears up for Iran escalation after US polls; Tehran says position unchanged
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump has signaled potential military action against Iran following the upcoming midterm elections. The US has increased its military presence in the Persian Gulf with additional aircraft and troops. Iran is reportedly preparing for retaliation against US and allied interests in the region. Both Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu may view renewed conflict as a political strategy.

stories.title: Kentucky court halts inquiry into widow's mental capacity after she rejects late husband's will
stories.summary: A Kentucky appeals court ruled that a district court could not investigate Tamara Williams' mental capacity claim. The dispute arose over her choice to reject her late husband Julian D. Williams' will for a statutory share. After her husband's death, Tamara's decision was contested by his stepchildren, who claimed she lacked mental capacity. The appeals court determined that contested cases must be resolved in circuit court rather than district court.

stories.title: Nobel laureate, Venezuela opposition leader Machado returns after exile
George Harrison donated his album royalties to charity. In 2024, his foundation spent £573,221
stories.summary: George Harrison's Material World Foundation continues to thrive, providing substantial funding to charitable initiatives worldwide. In 2024 alone, the foundation allocated over £573,000 towards public health, education, and emergency relief efforts. Operated independently by a board of trustees including Olivia Harrison, it eschews salaries to focus all resources on its mission. Founded from royalties of Harrison's classic album, Living in the Material World, the foundation's influence endures, promoting lasting change.

stories.title: New York couple pledges $10 million to expand NICU after granddaughter’s birth experience
stories.summary: Donald and Barbara Zucker have pledged a remarkable $10 million to elevate the standard of neonatal intensive care at Good Samaritan University Hospital. This generous commitment will be complemented by donations from the community, amplifying its reach. The initiative aims to upgrade the neonatal unit with cutting-edge technology and supportive amenities, ensuring high-risk newborns and their families receive essential care in a nurturing environment close to home.

stories.title: Kansas appeals court reopens divorce property case after jailed husband missed hearing next door
stories.summary: A Kansas appeals court recently vacated a previous ruling in a divorce property case, asserting that Scott L. Hale was not given a fair chance to participate. Haltingly unable to attend his hearing due to incarceration, Scott's objections to the property division were overlooked by the trial judge. The court's decision sends the matter back to the lower court for a comprehensive reassessment and new hearing.

stories.title: Give mayors real powers, ensure timely civic audits, urban body heads tell Centre
Texas student builds landscaping business to fund college, wins national agribusiness award
stories.summary: Texas student Jose Yepez started a landscaping business to pay for college, but it soon grew into a company serving more than 100 clients and employing four full-time workers. The business has also helped him support his family financially. His efforts earned him the 2026 American Star in Agribusiness award from the National FFA Organization on Friday.

stories.title: 80-ton boulder collapses at park after 104 years, smashing a walkway but injuring no one
stories.summary: In a surprising turn of events on October 18, 2026, an 80-ton granite boulder collapsed at Polar Caves Park in Rumney, New Hampshire, smashing a wooden walkway and its safety rails. Fortunately, this incident resulted in no injuries. The boulder's fall is likely due to weather-related erosion. Park authorities are now assessing the situation and implementing repair plans to allow for a safe return of visitors in spring 2027.

stories.title: Alabama lawyer gave up career to care for parents, but court upheld cancellation of her condo deed
stories.summary: The Alabama Supreme Court has affirmed a lower court's ruling that invalidated a property transfer from parents to their daughter, Holly Schumpert. Despite her dedication in caring for her ailing parents, the court determined the coastal condominium was part of a family trust, rendering the deed null. As a result, laws designed to protect elderly property owners allowed the reversal, leading to Holly having no claim to the estate.

stories.title: Delhi Police file FIR against opposition MPs over alleged trespassing at Jamia during student protest
stories.summary: The Delhi Police has launched an FIR targeting Congress MPs who attended the student protests at Jamia Millia Islamia. The MPs are accused of entering the university without permission amid ongoing demands for reinstating the students' union. Protesters are also calling for a halt to disciplinary measures against students and improved campus facilities, while university officials draft guidelines for upcoming union elections, adding to the complexity of the situation.

stories.title: Women founders are building India's social startups, their representation in nonprofits outpaces corporate leadership by a big margin, shows study
'I am here. With you': Maria Corina Machado returns to Venezuela from exile
Trump says he needs to 'stop killing Iranian leaders' to find someone to negotiate with
DNA evidence solves 2012 murder of North Carolina student Faith Hedgepeth, 14 years later
stories.summary: Miguel Salguero Olivares has received a life sentence for the chilling murder of Faith Hedgepeth, whose case remained a mystery for nearly ten years. Thanks to DNA evidence, he was arrested and convicted of first-degree murder, rape, and burglary. Faith's lifeless body was found in her apartment in September 2012 after a fun night out.

stories.title: After years of abandonment, 48 acres once home to Ohio's SeaWorld and Six Flags parks are set to reopen on October 25
stories.summary: Aurora Park at Geauga Lake will reopen to the public on October 25, focusing on outdoor recreation. This redevelopment includes seating areas, boating access, and restored structures from the amusement park era. Future phases will introduce a public beach, playground, and other recreational facilities as part of the project. The City of Aurora acquired the property in December 2024 to ensure public access.

stories.title: Arctic ice had been expanding for 1,000 years before reaching its greatest extent around 1960
stories.summary: A recent study indicates that the Barnes Ice Cap had begun expanding nearly 2,000 years ago. This expansion was attributed to cooler summer conditions that allowed ice to grow. However, rising greenhouse gas emissions reversed this trend and caused significant ice retreat since the 1960s. Researchers emphasize that human-induced warming has disrupted natural climate patterns that favored renewed glacial growth.

stories.title: Pope Leo urges end to Yemen violence after lung cancer surgery
Lost Joan Eardley painting found in charity shop after 64 years, selling for £29,500 for research
stories.summary: In an unexpected twist, a stunning landscape painting by Scottish talent Joan Eardley was discovered in an English charity shop. Named Summer Fields, the artwork fetched an impressive £29,500, with proceeds dedicated to funding medical research. After a paper label revealed its authenticity, the piece was returned to Scotland for further evaluation. This sale highlights the increasing appreciation for Eardley’s influence on mid-20th century art, celebrated in various exhibitions.

stories.title: 'Pakistan has no right': Congress distances itself from ally Farooq Abdullah's Kashmiri remark
About 1,300 abuse survivors agree to an $800m NY Catholic Church settlement, pending signatures
stories.summary: The Catholic Archdiocese of New York has reached an $800 million settlement for around 1,300 survivors of sexual abuse. This settlement resulted from lawsuits filed under the Child Victims Act, which allowed claims despite prior time limits. Payments will be determined through an independent review process based on the severity of the abuse and its impact. The archdiocese plans to improve transparency by releasing more records related to accused clergy.

stories.title: Built in 1834, a 75,000-pound Métis home crossed Georgian Bay after its owner sold it for $2
stories.summary: The historic Labatte House, a Métis residence from 1834, is set to be carefully moved to Balm Beach to ensure its preservation. Weighing approximately 75,000 pounds, the relocation is a meticulous endeavor across Georgian Bay. This effort seeks to create a museum dedicated to Indigenous and Métis narratives in the area, with restoration scheduled to start soon and a concrete foundation expected by spring 2027.

stories.title: After surviving cardiac arrest in 2023, Damar Hamlin helped 1,293 people learn CPR in one hour
stories.summary: Damar Hamlin set a Guinness World Record by successfully teaching hands-only CPR to 1,293 individuals at Acrisure Stadium. This event, part of a broader initiative in partnership with the American Heart Association, aimed to raise awareness about cardiac emergencies and emphasize the importance of immediate response. Fueled by his personal experience with cardiac arrest, Hamlin sought to empower his community with life-saving skills for potential emergencies.

stories.title: Crystal Drinkwalter & Jazmyn Canning built a $52K natural pond on their 65-acre land, saving $148K
stories.summary: On their sprawling 65-acre property, Crystal Drinkwalter and Jazmyn Canning took on the ambitious project of building a natural swimming pond after being deterred by high contractor fees. Through hard work, they relocated more than 100,000 pounds of rock and lined the pond by hand. It took eight water trucks to fill their 110,000-gallon pond with water. For a detailed look at this impressive feat, visit their YouTube channel.

stories.title: Mallikarjun Kharge’s 'baap' remark on PM Modi sparks row, BJP hits back
Trump's 250-foot arch could see construction begin November 5 despite pending legal challenge
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump's proposed 250-foot triumphal arch in Washington could begin construction as early as November 5, pending final approvals. However, three military veterans and a retired architectural historian have asked a federal judge to stop the work, arguing that congressional authorisation is required. The project faces two lawsuits questioning its approval process and legality.

stories.title: US midterms 2026: Meet Pia Dandiya, Indian-origin Democrat running for Florida’s open 22nd House seat
PM Modi inaugurates RBI's Rs 169-crore data centre, cybersecurity institute in Odisha
Israel elections: Can Netanyahu turn security gains into a political victory?
stories.summary: Israeli voters will head to the polls on October 27 in a significant election for Benjamin Netanyahu. His political future hinges on addressing security failures following the October 7 attack by Hamas. Gadi Eisenkot has emerged as a primary challenger, emphasizing military accountability over Netanyahu's leadership. The election highlights divisions within the opposition and potential coalition challenges.

stories.title: Indian American physician Navin Shah commits $525,000 to infectious disease program in Pune
stories.summary: Dr. Navin C. Shah has committed $525,000 to establish a new infectious disease program at BJ Government Medical College. The initiative aims to enhance research, medical training, and patient care for underserved communities in Pune. Collaborating with Johns Hopkins University, the program will focus on public health challenges like tuberculosis and HIV. Faculty and student exchanges are also planned to foster international cooperation in medicine.

stories.title: ‘Don’t encourage Jinnah worship’: Keralam BJP chief Chandrashekhar targets CM Satheesan amid Fort Kochi video row
BSF apprehends four Pakistani fishermen in Kutch, seizes boat
stories.summary: On Sunday, four Pakistani fishermen were intercepted by the Border Security Force in the Kutch district of Gujarat. Suspected of illegally fishing in Indian waters for crabs, they were detained following precise intelligence alerts. The crew members, hailing from Chach Jaan Khan village in Sindh province, are now under investigation as the BSF maintains vigilance over the sensitive border region to thwart unauthorized entries.

stories.title: 'Too deferential to govt': Former SC judge questions ex-CJI Chandrachud’s approach to appointments
stories.summary: Congress flags judicial independence concerns over claims in ex SC judge's memoir

stories.title: 24-year-old Coast Guard swimmer rescues 16 people from Pacific shipwreck after two hours in darkness
stories.summary: A US Coast Guard rescue swimmer undertook a challenging operation to save 16 individuals from the Pacific Ocean. The rescue followed a distress call regarding a capsized boat off Mexico's Baja California. Over 2,441 square miles were searched, but 11 victims remain missing as the search was suspended. Investigation into the vessel's circumstances is ongoing, and survivors received medical care before being processed under US immigration law.

stories.title: 'Some still allow political calculations': Jaishankar's veiled swipe days after Rubio backs Pak ties
'Second war of independence': Kharge targets BJP-RSS, calls for nationwide movement against SIR
No need to take blood pressure pills now? Scientists are testing a device that can reduce BP by stimulating nerves
stories.summary: A recent study shows that stimulating the ear can help lower blood pressure. Known as transcutaneous autonomic neuromodulation, this innovative approach may offer an effective solution for managing hypertension. In a clinical trial with 63 participants who struggled with uncontrolled hypertension despite medication, those with severe cases displayed encouraging results. However, further research is essential to validate the efficacy of this non-invasive technique.

stories.title: DK Shivakumar's big warning to Bengaluru IT firms over sidelining Kannadiga candidates
A former army chief, 2 ex-PMs and an Arab party leader: Netanyahu’s main rivals in Israel polls
In the 1940s, Ohio built a 200-foot dam for a village; now, it’s restoring a 14-mile creek
stories.summary: Ohio's Cloverlick Dam, built in the 1940s, is being removed to restore the natural flow of Cloverlick Creek. This restoration project aims to improve water quality and reconnect aquatic habitats that have been disrupted for decades. Removal of the dam is expected to create a safer environment for recreational activities like fishing and kayaking. Funding for the project is being provided by the H2Ohio Rivers Program and federal grants.

stories.title: Kentucky couple transferred $210,000 land for $1; appeals court upholds sale over $177,668 debt
stories.summary: A property transfer for just $1 has failed to shield a Kentucky couple’s land from a creditor seeking to recover an unpaid debt. In an October 23, 2026, opinion, the Kentucky Court of Appeals upheld an order allowing property assessed at approximately $210,000 to be sold to satisfy a judgment of $177,667.88, plus applicable costs and attorney fees.

stories.title: Natalie Portman's €15.2 million Paris mansion near the Eiffel Tower has a 100-year-old history
stories.summary: Natalie Portman purchased a 550-square-metre mansion in Paris for €15.2 million in September 2023. Built in 1912, the four-storey property once served as an embassy before undergoing extensive renovation. Located near the Eiffel Tower, the residence features a garden, gym, library, wine cellar and a glass-roofed reception room. The actress bought the property months before her divorce from Benjamin Millepied was finalised.

stories.title: Robert Kraft’s anti-hate group raises $32m at gala with Tom Brady, Jon Bon Jovi and 800 guests
stories.summary: More than 800 guests gathered at New York’s Waldorf Astoria on October 21, 2026, for an evening that combined celebrity appearances, philanthropy and a campaign against antisemitism and discrimination. The inaugural benefit gala of the Blue Square Alliance Against Hate, founded by New England Patriots owner Robert Kraft, raised more than $32 million.

stories.title: J. M. Barrie and Keith Emerson’s former Sussex home lists for £3.75 million
ECINET row: Congress questions EC after poll body refuses to share details of ‘controversial’ software
'Don't film missiles': India advises its nationals in Saudi Arabia amid ongoing Houthi strikes
A festival, a DJ and a complaint: What residents can legally do about noise
David Gilmour’s Former Essex farmhouse listed for £1.1 million
‘Vote chori’ protests: Kharge asks Congress MPs to be in Delhi from Oct 30-Nov 1
‘Give priority to local artisans’: PM Modi’s festive shopping appeal as Diwali approaches
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged citizens to support local artisans by prioritizing their products while shopping for festivals. He emphasized that doing so would strengthen the 'Vocal for Local' campaign and promote a self-reliant India. Modi highlighted successful local exports such as makhana and arhar dal to various international markets. Additionally, he discussed efforts aimed at reviving traditional skills and farming practices, including natural cotton cultivation.

stories.title: 'Now that Nitish is no longer there': Expelled Anant Singh says has no regrets, to float own party
New York mother jailed for kidnapping her child wins fresh hearing over $500 child-support cap
stories.summary: A New York woman serving a seven-year prison sentence for kidnapping her child has won a fresh hearing over unpaid child support. Chelsea Four-Rosenbaum had sought to limit her debt to $500, arguing that her income remained below federal poverty guidelines while imprisoned. An appeals court ruled that her request had been examined under the wrong legal provision and ordered a fresh review.

stories.title: Kentucky appeals court overturns ruling favouring husband in $703,000 farm dispute
stories.summary: Mary and Fred Holden's property settlement agreed to equal ownership of their Kentucky farm. Disagreements arose regarding when the farm should be listed for sale after two years. After their son moved out, Mary requested the farm be sold or purchased by Fred. The appeals court found the agreement's wording ambiguous, requiring a fresh evaluation in family court.

stories.title: Renovate California Beachfront Home: Planning shows Kutcher, Kunis expand retreat; cottage to go
stories.summary: Ashton Kutcher and Mila Kunis are planning a significant renovation of their Carpinteria beachfront property. The proposed changes include expanding the main residence and adding a swimming pool. They acquired the property in 2017 for $10.1 million and have seen its estimated value rise to about $17 million. The couple's plans involve the removal of a guest cottage to enhance the outdoor living space.

stories.title: Bill Kaulitz renovates Lloyd Wright-designed Hollywood Hills home after water damage
Ukraine drone attacks kill three, injure 14 in Russia’s Belgorod region
stories.summary: A drone strike carried out by Ukrainian forces hit Belgorod, leading to two confirmed deaths and injuring at least 13 people. Local officials highlighted significant destruction to housing, vehicles, and local infrastructure. Additionally, a nearby village reported another fatality and injuries stemming from the ongoing hostilities. These events underscore the ongoing violence escalating along the Russia-Ukraine border, and tensions continue to mount in the region.

stories.title: Trump claims US has secured Greenland, Venezuela in ‘greatest real estate deal’
stories.summary: Donald Trump asserted at a rally that the United States has secured Greenland and Venezuela as territories. His statements were made despite the lack of legal transfer of sovereignty over Greenland from Denmark. A recent memorandum of understanding focused on maritime cooperation, which does not include Greenland. Trump also announced a significant investment by Audi in Georgia, emphasizing job creation.

stories.title: Man tries to sell home for $150,000, but cousin's four-year-old verbal deal holds up in court
stories.summary: A Kansas woman who claimed she agreed to buy her cousin's house and five acres of land in 2020 has won a property dispute after he received a $150,000 offer from another buyer. Tiffany Miller had taken over mortgage payments and made extensive repairs, but her cousin denied agreeing to sell. The Kansas Court of Appeals has upheld their verbal agreement.

stories.title: Pakistan-Iran Trade Resumes: Key border crossing reopens after attack; LPG relief expected
stories.summary: Following a week-long closure due to security threats, Pakistan has reopened the Gabd-Rimdan border crossing with Iran. This pivotal reopening facilitates the flow of commercial goods that had been halted, leading to concerns regarding the availability of LPG and rising food and energy costs as winter neared. Enhanced security protocols are now in place to safeguard transport, bringing much-needed relief to local traders and transporters.

stories.title: 'Don't be spectator, show leadership': EAM Jaishankar to UN on terrorism, global crises
stories.summary: In his latest statements, external affairs minister S Jaishankar called for a more robust leadership from the UN to confront pressing world issues. He highlighted a significant gap in global decision-making that leaves many regions, particularly in the Global South, behind in critical areas like finance, fuel, food, and fertilizer. Emphasizing the importance of fair AI development, Jaishankar encourages strategies that ensure widespread access to its benefits, fostering international cooperation.

stories.title: Centre rushes 250 RAF personnel to Arunachal after violent protests over hydropower project
stories.summary: The Centre has deployed two Rapid Action Force companies comprising around 250 CRPF personnel to Arunachal Pradesh following violent protests against the proposed 11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project. A mob torched an NHPC office and a police station in Pasighat, injuring over 40 police personnel. The project, seen as a strategic counter to China’s mega dam, faces opposition from indigenous tribes fearing displacement and submergence of villages.

stories.title: Protests engulf Europe: People take to streets in France, Albania, Italy, Spain, Portugal
stories.summary: Thousands of people protested across Europe over the weekend, demanding action against rising living costs and government corruption. Demonstrations were reported in France, Italy, Albania, Spain, and Portugal, with varying degrees of violence. Clashes between protesters and police resulted in numerous arrests and injuries in several countries. Many demonstrators called for affordable housing, better education, and protection of public pensions.

stories.title: Who is Gadi Eisenkot? Ex-army chief of Israel is Netanyahu's biggest challenger in PM race
Luxury Condo Deposits At Risk: buyers fight for refunds as foreclosure looms; branding future uncertain
stories.summary: Nilesh Undavia and other buyers are struggling to receive their deposits for unfinished luxury condos in Boca Raton. The Mandarin Oriental Residences project has faced significant construction delays, impacting buyers' financial investments. A $417.7 million foreclosure lawsuit complicates the situation for prospective homeowners seeking refunds. Penn-Florida Companies attributes delays to various challenges, including rising construction costs and supply-chain issues.

stories.title: Meet Leo Park, the 16-year-old South Korean artist whose drawings feature in a UK colouring book
stories.summary: South Korean teenager Leo Park, 16, who began sharing his architectural sketches on Instagram in 2019, has collaborated with British company Colour Your Streets on a colouring book featuring 30 UK cities. Known for his detailed freehand drawings, Park combines architecture, history and imagination in his work. The self-taught artist has also published other books and hopes to explore India's architectural heritage.

stories.title: 'Not less than a pilgrimage’: PM Modi marks 12 years of Mann Ki Baat - top quotes
‘Foreign-funded conspiracy to destabilise India’: Telangana BJP chief targets Congress over Jamia graffiti
6 children among 12 injured in shooting near Florida university stadium
stories.summary: A shooting occurred near a football stadium in Tallahassee during homecoming weekend at Florida A&M University. At least 12 individuals were injured, which included six children, and 11 had gunshot wounds. Authorities reported that three victims suffered serious injuries, with one critically injured and eight stable. The police chief indicated an altercation had preceded the shooting, but no arrests have been made.

stories.title: US Midterm Elections: Trump blasts France’s immigration policy at rally; Macron pushes back
stories.summary: During a recent rally, Donald Trump voiced his disapproval of France's immigration policies, coinciding with widespread protests that saw nearly 1,000 arrests due to rising living costs. Clashes marked the demonstrations, prompting French President Emmanuel Macron to respond to foreign criticisms, while Netanyahu also commented on France’s approach to dealing with extremism. These events have escalated public outcry regarding education and economic conditions.

stories.title: 'Thanks BJP for promoting': Rahul Gandhi takes swipe at Centre over Nov 1 rally at Delhi's Ramlila Maidan
stories.summary: On November 1, Rahul Gandhi is set to lead a rally to rally citizens against alleged vote theft, spotlighting issues like voter list inaccuracies and the response to complainants. The BJP has voiced concerns over the timing due to its proximity to the 1984 anti-Sikh riots memorial. Several organizations, including Delhi's Chamber of Trade and Industry, have expressed disapproval.

stories.title: Skidoo attracted 700 people after a 1906 gold discovery before its decline
PM Modi to inaugurate RBI's Rs 169-crore data centre in Bhubaneswar, second after Navi Mumbai
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate the Reserve Bank of India's data centre and Cybersecurity Training Institute. This inauguration is aimed at strengthening Odisha's digital infrastructure and enhancing financial data security. The data centre in Jatni will be the second of its kind in the country, following Navi Mumbai. Modi's visit includes a helicopter journey to Khurda before reaching the data centre.

stories.title: Invasive Garlic mustard spreads across 37 US states and six Canadian provinces
Drug trafficking crackdown: Amit Shah hails Operation Trident; Rs 100 crore hawala transactions exposed, 18 arrested
stories.summary: Union home minister Amit Shah announced Operation Trident, which targeted an international narcotics cartel in India. The operation, conducted in Assam, Mizoram, and Manipur, uncovered significant hawala transactions and led to arrests. Authorities froze numerous bank accounts and seized illegal items, including detonators and cash. Shah emphasized the government's commitment to eradicating drug networks by December 31, 2029.

stories.title: 'Ignore strike calls': LPG distributor body ahead of Rahul Gandhi's rally in Delhi
Quake Hits Vanuatu: 6.2 tremor strikes at 125 km depth; no damage reports yet
stories.summary: On October 25, the Vanuatu islands experienced a magnitude 6.2 earthquake, originating at a depth of 125 kilometers. This region, known for its seismic volatility and volcanic activity, felt the quake's impact; however, its depth typically minimizes surface shaking. As of now, there are no reports of damage or injuries.

stories.title: Abandoned New Jersey military site to become $70M community near Netflix studio
6.3-magnitude earthquake strikes Bonin Islands region of Japan
‘Will never be safe’: Houthis warn as Riyadh airport resumes flights
stories.summary: King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh has resumed flight operations following a significant security situation. The airport management has designated specific terminals for domestic and international flights, effective immediately. Meanwhile, the Houthi military spokesperson has reiterated threats against the airport, labeling it a military target. Airlines such as Air India and Air India Express have suspended services to Saudi Arabia as a precaution.

stories.title: 'Lie and fabrication': Iran denies Hormuz deal offer to US through Pakistan
'To kill people': Musk accuses Ukraine military of misusing Starlink for drone strikes
Minnesota man jumps onto moving school bus, saves 19 children after driver collapses
Frogan Crowdfunds Legal Fees: Twitch streamer faces $73K bill; fundraiser hits $45,491
stories.summary: Twitch streamer Frogan is seeking donations after Ethan Klein’s company voluntarily dismissed its copyright lawsuit against her on September 8, 2026. Frogan says she still owes $73,000 in legal fees, with total expenses exceeding $100,000. Her GoFundMe campaign has a $200,000 target. Although the dismissal offers relief after more than a year of litigation, it was without prejudice, meaning the company could potentially refile the lawsuit.

stories.title: ‘Prioritise welfare over military directives’: India raps Pak on minority rights at UN
stories.summary: Speaking at an interactive dialogue with the Special Rapporteur on Minority Issues at the UN General Assembly's Third Committee, India's First Secretary at the Permanent Mission to the UN, Raghoo Puri, called out Pakistan's conduct and said its representatives should focus on the welfare of their own people instead of taking directions from the military.

stories.title: Streamer Issues Cease-And-Desist: Kai Cenat challenges online allegations; Reggie releases music video
stories.summary: Kai Cenat has reportedly sent former friend Reggie a cease-and-desist letter over alleged false claims involving serious misconduct. His legal team denied the allegations and demanded that Reggie remove related social media posts. Reggie responded publicly, questioned the letter’s focus and released a music video titled ‘Watch Me!’ that appears to reference the dispute. The controversy has sparked divided reactions online, but no court ruling establishing responsibility has been reported in the provided account.

stories.title: Suspicious pigeon with coded ring, Pak currency causes a flutter in Jammu
stories.summary: An official pointed out that such episodes are not uncommon in border areas of J&K and Punjab, where pigeons have been used for smuggling or for sending messages across the frontier. On Saturday, the pigeon was found near a temple in Samba’s border area of Mawa around 6.40am and was immediately captured by locals after they spotted a ring tied to its leg.

stories.title: Solar storm delayed a train by 16 minutes in 1848, not 1841: How scientists solved a 155-year-old mystery
stories.summary: A fascinating correction has emerged from the archives concerning a train delay in Exeter. Initially reported incorrectly, researchers have clarified that the incident actually transpired on October 18, 1848. This revelation was achieved through the analysis of railway records and contemporary newspapers, alongside geomagnetic data, which pointed to a significant solar storm influencing the delay during that time.

stories.title: Dallas homeowners lost their $58,150 repair claim after a court ruled they filed too late
stories.summary: A federal appeals court has ruled against Dallas residents who sought over $58,000 from State Farm for water damage from a 2021 freeze, determining that their lawsuit was not filed within the required timeframe of their insurance policy. State Farm had already compensated for initial damages but denied further claims, especially since the homeowners declined additional living costs during property repairs.

stories.title: Rs 10 lakh cover for 45 paise: Counter rail ticket buyers get insurance option
stories.summary: The scheme has provision for payment of Rs 7.5 lakh for permanent partial disability and up to Rs 2 lakh for hospitalisation expenses arising from injuries, as well as Rs 10,000 towards transportation of mortal remains of deceased passengers. The Railway Board has directed all its zones to implement the facility.

stories.title: CBI files FIR against IL&FS Energy, top execs in Rs 212cr Canara Bank loan fraud case
stories.summary: CBI has named M/s IL&FS Energy Development Company Ltd, its MD and directors — Sunil Wadhwa, Anoop Seth, Hari Sankaran, Ramesh Chandra Bawa and Arun Kumar Saha — and unknown public servants and private individuals as accused. The case was registered on Oct 21 following a complaint by Canara Bank’s circle office in Bandra.

stories.title: Alleged Mortgage Fraud Exposed: Lawsuits detail DSCR loan flips; Baltimore housing suffers
stories.summary: In 2022, a property in Baltimore purchased for $43,000 astonishingly changed hands for $310,000 just a year later. This sharp spike in valuation has led to accusations of inflated property prices by investors, resulting in numerous foreclosures. Federal lawsuits allege a scheme involving over 150 properties generating millions in loans, prompting lender scrutiny and investigations into the housing market, revealing Baltimore's deep-seated issues with housing insecurity.

stories.title: ED moves Supreme Court against HC order to quash case against portal, founder
stories.summary: The directorate, which filed an appeal almost five months after the HC pronounced the order on May 29, also took the ground that the HC passed the order five months and 26 days after the judgement was reserved and it was in violation of SC’s guidelines that the verdict should be delivered within three months.

stories.title: Defer Nov 1 rally, will hit festive business, traders urge Rahul; BJP raps Congress
stories.summary: CTI chairman Brijesh Goyal said Delhi records Rs 25,000 crore in business on Dhanteras across major sectors. CTI claimed that traders suffered losses of Rs 3,000 crore in Oct due to rallies and road closures in Connaught Place, India Gate and central Delhi. BJP claimed some Congress allies have disagreed with Rahul Gandhi’s decision to hold the rally on Nov 1.

stories.title: Interview | ‘AAP had 4.5 years to end drug menace, gangsterism in Punjab’: Sachin Pilot
stories.summary: "BJP has no strong footing in Punjab and has survived on the back of SAD support. But SAD has also split and is facing internal issues. It is not the force like they were under Badal Senior. It will be a bipolar contest over who can lead Punjab better. There will be other players like Amritpal Singh’s party, but people of Punjab don’t give a fractured mandate," Sachin Pilot said.

stories.title: Canadian University allows convicted murderer on day parole to attend law course, major outrage among students
No EC nod needed for voter to sue candidate over false information: Supreme Court
stories.summary: A bench of Justices Dipankar Datta and Sheel Nagu quashed the Karnataka HC order which had held that “right given to the voter is only to file an election petition, and not to register a private complaint of crime which is the duty of the Election Commission, if it wants to do so”.

stories.title: 170-year-old portrait sold for $882 in 2025 fetches $230,400 after man's identity is discovered
stories.summary: A photograph that fetched $882 at a New York auction last year has now been identified as a portrait of George Boyer Vashon, the first licensed African American lawyer in New York State. Experts recognized its historical significance, leading Sotheby's to auction it for an astonishing $230,400, far surpassing its initial estimate. This revelation underscores the profound impact of historical context on art valuation.

stories.title: Ohio court upheld Wells Fargo’s $449,905 foreclosure after three loan modifications over 17 years
stories.summary: In a recent decision, an Ohio appeals court upheld the foreclosure ruling against Sandra Doberdruk, stemming from her unpaid mortgage. Doberdruk's financial troubles escalated after her husband's passing in 2009, despite her attempts to modify her loan thrice. Wells Fargo eventually moved forward with foreclosure after missed payments, and the court ruled that her late husband's estate was not a necessary party in the proceedings.

stories.title: Mellon Foundation donates $750,000 grant to University of California to establish South Asian American studies centre
Farooq Abdullah's comments on Pakistan and Kashmir draw flak
stories.summary: Farooq urged NC workers and legislators to remain loyal to the party, whether in power or not, as he touched on a range of issues in his speech. “Hold on to the truth. Speaking the truth is not easy, but unless you remain truthful and stand up for what is right, your future will never be secure,” the veteran said.

stories.title: Daughter’s inheritance rights can’t be defeated by limitation: J&K and Ladakh high court
stories.summary: The dispute dates back to Sept 14, 1982, when Themu, daughter of late Sonu, filed a civil suit claiming half share in land measuring 58 kanals and 11 marlas left behind by her father. She challenged mutation no. 43 dated Oct 15, 1966, which had been entered exclusively in favour of one Shib Devi and sought declaration of her inheritance rights along with consequential possession.

stories.title: Set to expand cabinet, J&K CM Omar Abdullah asks hopefuls not to ‘mob or spam’ him
stories.summary: J&K CM Omar Abdullah advised them against knocking on his doors or that of his father and National Conference president, Dr Farooq Abdullah, to lobby for ministerial positions. After meeting Sinha, Omar told reporters he sought an appointment with him for next week so that he can make changes and expand his council of ministers.

stories.title: 'I'm on the brink of breaking down': Indian woman forced to leave Australia before settling late brother’s estate after visa waiver rejection
9-year-old can write 10 languages and a dozen fonts
stories.summary: Meet Sebastian Esposito, a 9-year-old prodigy from New Mexico, gifted with the ability to write in an impressive ten languages. Diagnosed with autism, his journey took a remarkable turn when he developed hyperlexia, allowing him to read at an early age. With a knack for memorizing the periodic table and identifying flags by their shapes, Sebastian’s parents showcase his extraordinary talents on social media to foster autism awareness.

stories.title: 4 people stabbed at New York home; woman shot by cops after charging at officers with knife
Drone strikes kill 3: Kyiv hits Omsk plant and Ozon hub; power cut in Crimea and east
stories.summary: Ukraine launched drone strikes against Russian targets in Omsk, hitting a petrochemical plant and a warehouse. In retaliation, a Russian drone attack on Ukraine's Dnipropetrovsk region resulted in three civilian deaths and injuries. The strikes also caused significant disruptions to electricity in Crimea and other occupied areas of Ukraine. Power restoration efforts are ongoing as residents face temporary power cuts.

stories.title: NY court dismissed a foreclosure case after the lender waited three years to seek a default ruling
stories.summary: In a significant ruling, a New York appeals court has supported the dismissal of a mortgage foreclosure lawsuit against a borrower after the lender delayed three years to seek a default judgment. New York regulations stipulate that lenders must act within one year of a borrower's non-response to avoid case dismissal. This decision reinforces homeowner protections and emphasizes the importance of timely legal actions in foreclosure matters.

stories.title: Hilda Payin’s 200+ autographs, including Babe Ruth and Amelia Earhart, sell for $28,759 at auction
stories.summary: A remarkable scrapbook assembled by Hilda Jeanne Payin in the 1930s was auctioned for an impressive $28,759. This unique collection boasts over 200 signatures from iconic figures across sports, politics, and entertainment, including legends like Babe Ruth and Amelia Earhart, as well as presidents Calvin Coolidge and Herbert Hoover. Each item features personal notes linking them closely to Payin, creating a fascinating historical narrative of 20th-century influencers.

stories.title: US citizenship application gathering dust: Taiwanese Green Card holder sues Trump administration for making him wait around 18 months
Congress high command steps in, asks Karnataka govt to probe alleged sting attempts on CMs
British woman dies trying to rescue sons swept away by strong current while snorkelling in Bahamas
‘PMLA case not examined’: ED moves Supreme Court against HC order quashing proceedings against NewsClick
Former Starbucks boss ordered to remove illegal tennis court from Hampshire land
Sturges House Preservation Dispute: Neglect now threatens Wright landmark; code violations fuel showdown
stories.summary: The Sturges House, an architectural masterpiece by Frank Lloyd Wright completed in 1939, is facing severe preservation challenges. Preservationists warn of significant neglect and deterioration of this Los Angeles landmark. While the property owner asserts millions spent on upkeep, ongoing concerns linger unresolved. Urgent action is needed as preservation groups and city officials scrutinize the potential loss of the structure's iconic cantilever feature.

stories.title: In 2016, a Texas couple took in 2 goats in their tiny South Austin backyard; 10 years later, Austin Farm Sanctuary covers 95 acres
stories.summary: In 2016, Chris Fuller-Wigg and Angela established the Austin Farm Sanctuary after rescuing a pair of goats, marking the beginning of a transformative journey. Today, the sanctuary spans 95 acres and shelters around 240 animals, many of whom are elderly or disabled. With its innovative LEAP program, visitors engage in hands-on experiences that foster compassion for farm animals, challenging traditional views and promoting a kinder perspective on these sentient beings.

stories.title: Helen Mirren, 81, is on a mission to save Italy’s 1,500-year-old olive trees from deadly bacteria
stories.summary: Helen Mirren, 81, is fighting to save Italy’s ancient olive trees from Xylella fastidiosa, a deadly bacterium that has reportedly destroyed around 22 million trees since 2013. Through her initiative, Save the Olives, the Oscar winner is supporting conservation efforts and developing resistant varieties. “We have to save these trees,” she says.

stories.title: RG Kar victim's parents question ex-principal Sandip Ghosh's bail; citizens' groups plan CBI office march
stories.summary: The parents of the RG Kar victim are expressing their outrage over the bail granted to Sandip Ghosh, insisting that the investigation into their daughter's tragic death must be held accountable. Plans are underway for a protest organized by citizens' groups, pressing the Central Bureau of Investigation for urgent action. Family members and medical professionals alike have raised serious concerns regarding the efficacy and integrity of the ongoing investigation.

stories.title: 'Opposes BJP by lineage': BJP MLA's swipe at Naseeruddin Shah over SRFTI row
EC declares UP MLC poll at three Agra stations 'void', orders repoll on October 26
‘Act of treason’: BJP slams Farooq Abdullah over claim 'Pakistan is protecting Kashmiris'
stories.summary: In recent developments, BJP leaders have taken strong issue with Farooq Abdullah's comments regarding Pakistan's alleged support for Kashmiris. Abdullah, speaking at a workers' gathering, cast doubt on the central government's approach to Jammu and Kashmir, raising questions about India's commitment to justice. In response, BJP representatives charged him with treason, claiming his remarks weaken India's stance on the issue.

stories.title: 'Moved back to India 7 years ago, planning to move out again': Redditor gives reality check
‘Sri Lanka, Bangladesh happen when protests are not allowed’: Sonam Wangchuk on anti-SIR stir crackdown
A NY court ruled a husband’s loan on his own home to buy a marital house must be paid from its sale
stories.summary: In a significant ruling, a New York appeals court has set guidelines for managing debts tied to a marital home amid divorce. The judges determined that a husband can recoup his home equity loan debt from proceeds of a jointly owned house. This arose from a loan secured against his separate property, and the court ruled that debts incurred for marital assets are communal liabilities.

stories.title: Mark Wahlberg sells $15.6M Las Vegas plot for $17.25M
stories.summary: Mark Wahlberg's 2022 investment of $15.6 million in 2.5 acres in Las Vegas aimed to house a family home and studio, yet no construction took place, leading to a delay in permits. After two and a half years, he sold the land for $17.25 million, netting a profit of $1.65 million while also engaging in other local property transactions.

stories.title: Congress to launch door-to-door campaign, hold marches over voter list 'discrepancies'
stories.summary: Congress aims to register all eligible citizens by the end of December through an extensive campaign. The campaign will include marches, pamphlet distribution, and awareness meetings in both urban and rural areas. Booth-level agents will be appointed to help verify the accuracy of voter lists and report discrepancies. Allegations have arisen regarding significant irregularities affecting millions of voters across the country.

stories.title: CBI books IL&FS Energy Development Co. and top directors in Rs 212 crore Canara Bank fraud case
NMC weighs five-year rotation of HoDs after stakeholder feedback
stories.summary: The National Medical Commission is considering an update to the rotation period for heads of departments in medical colleges. This revision aims to change the tenure from three years to five years based on stakeholder feedback. The original proposal also included both professors and eligible associate professors, which will now be restricted. A detailed response to an RTI application has confirmed that the proposal is still under consideration.

stories.title: Kamala Harris returns to campaign trail for US midterms amid speculation over 2028 presidential bid
RML’s 666-bed super speciality block gets fire safety clearance, set to boost critical care
stories.summary: Dr Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital's new 666-bed super speciality block has successfully secured fire safety clearance, allowing the hospital's capacity to soar past 2,200 beds. This cutting-edge facility will house numerous operation theatres along with specialized units for intensive and high dependency care, focusing on enhancing treatment, particularly in oncology. The timeline for when services will start is still pending.

stories.title: Trump hints at moving White House press room ‘to less obnoxious location’
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump has denied plans to replace the press briefing room with a historic swimming pool. He suggested relocating journalists to a different area due to his ongoing conflicts with the media. Reports indicated that he discussed the pool restoration during a meeting with then-press secretary Karoline Leavitt. Trump's administration previously barred certain journalists from White House grounds but faced legal challenges.

stories.title: Florida couple builds 420-acre animal sanctuary
stories.summary: Erin and Chris Amerman acquired a 210-acre farm in 2015 and established Critter Creek Farm Sanctuary. They expanded their efforts to include a 200-acre ranch named Critter Hills in 2019. The sanctuary now shelters over 180 cows along with various other animals requiring care. Monthly tours and events aim to promote compassion for all animals. Their work emphasizes the need for space and resources to continue animal rescue efforts.

stories.title: Selena Gomez sold her California mansion for $5.4 million after buying $35 million marital home
stories.summary: After six years of ownership, Selena Gomez has sold her Encino residence for $5.399 million, which is less than the listed price of $6.5 million. This iconic property, formerly owned by Tom Petty, was the backdrop for her series 'Selena + Chef'. In December 2024, she purchased a stunning Beverly Hills estate for $35 million, ultimately marrying music producer Benny Blanco in September 2025 not long after getting engaged.

stories.title: 'We urge Indian businesses to continue and expand trade with Tehran': Envoy
‘Do you support demand for free Kashmir?’ BJP questions Congress over MP Imran Masood’s Jamia visit amid student protests
45 paise for Rs 10 lakh cover: Railways extends insurance to counter tickets from October 27
stories.summary: Starting October 27, Indian Railways will provide travelers the option to include an Optional Travel Insurance Scheme with their reservation ticket purchases. For a nominal fee of just 45 paise, passengers gain crucial coverage for accident-related incidents. The insurance offers various payout options tailored to medical and logistical emergencies. Reservation staff will be responsible for informing ticket buyers about this crucial add-on before finalizing bookings.

stories.title: Did Jeff Bezos just buy a $69.5 million Golden Beach mansion near Miami’s Billionaire Bunker?
stories.summary: A $69.5 million oceanfront mansion in Golden Beach, Florida, has set a local sales record, fuelling speculation about Jeff Bezos’ involvement. The 17,500-square-foot estate was purchased by Delaware-based Meridian Coast LLC, reportedly linked to the Amazon founder. If confirmed, the acquisition could add to Bezos’ reported $234 million real estate portfolio on Indian Creek Island.

stories.title: Bhutanese man shot and killed during robbery attempt at his jewelry store in Ohio, immigrant business owners say they are scared
Amit Shah visits Delhi police headquarters amid law and order concerns
Evening news wrap: Farooq Abdullah's Pak 'praise' sparks row; France protests begin under heavy security & more
'Tore Constitution to shreds': BJP president says anti-CEC protests by Congress undermined democracy
Jarange audio row: BJP claims Sanjay Raut made fake 'Rs 500 cr' audio clip; MP defends authenticity
Indiana couple’s fire insurance lawsuit revived after insurer denied claim over suspected arson
stories.summary: In November 2020, a couple in Richmond, Indiana, faced devastating property damage due to a fire that investigators deemed intentionally ignited. Despite an absence of a suspect, the insurance company rejected their claims, citing potential arson and insufficient cooperation. Now, an appeals court has enabled the couple's lawsuit to proceed, revealing unresolved issues concerning compliance with insurance policies and the expectation of good faith actions.

stories.title: An Idaho horse-racing track that fell silent in 2015 reopens as a $42 million 50 acre park
stories.summary: In a remarkable redevelopment initiative, Garden City, Idaho, has repurposed the old Les Bois horse-racing track into a vibrant public park, spanning nearly 50 acres. Known as the Park at Expo Idaho, it features diverse landscapes including wetlands and nature trails, alongside recreational facilities like a newly designed skate park. This transformation promotes outdoor activities and ecological restoration while already drawing in local wildlife.

stories.title: Iowa begins $4.9 million effort to reclaim 150 acres of mines;state says 7,195 acres restored
stories.summary: The Iowa Department of Agriculture has launched a reclamation initiative targeting environmental challenges posed by abandoned coal mines. Covering approximately 150 acres in Mahaska and Marion counties, the project aims to revitalize water quality and enhance soil health in these areas. Past reclamation successes have notably improved local ecosystems, showcasing a dedicated effort to rehabilitate devastated landscapes for sustainable future use.

stories.title: Five Italian women activists released, repatriated after detention by Israel in West Bank
Boston man convicted after repeatedly touching minor through seat gap on JetBlue flight
IUML expels member as BJP leader surrenders in Rs 8-crore Doha theft case
'Our neighbour protecting us': Farooq makes shocking remark on J&K; BJP hits back
France on edge: Thousands on streets as weekend of protests begin; 70k cops deployed
stories.summary: France is taking significant measures to manage mounting tensions, deploying around 70,000 police officers to supervise protests over education funding and escalating living costs. In response to previous violent outbreaks, authorities have restricted protest routes. Major Parisian museums and shops have temporarily closed to prevent potential chaos as demands for enhanced educational opportunities, better salaries, and improved public services grow.

stories.title: Florida man ordered to pay ex-wife $50,000 in legal fees over hidden rental records
stories.summary: After a lengthy divorce trial, Luis Garcia was ordered to pay $50,000 in attorney’s fees to Ruth Garcia. The judge found that Luis intentionally withheld important financial information regarding their rental properties. This withholding was deemed egregious and constituted bad-faith conduct during the litigation process. While the fee award was upheld, the appellate court questioned how the specific amount was determined.

stories.title: Adam Levine sells historic Los Angeles estate for $51 million after $32M buy
Louisiana volunteers turn 200 tons of discarded oyster shells into living reef; oyster numbers more than double
stories.summary: Dedicated volunteers have harnessed recycled oyster shells to construct a vital reef in Grand Bayou Indian Village, aimed at addressing the critical challenges of land loss driven by erosion and climate change. Initial monitoring results reveal a promising boost in live oyster populations after just a year.
