stories.title: 1 Indian killed, 2 injured in Dammam airport attack in Saudi Arabia
'You want to protect infiltrators' votes': Amit Shah's sharp attack on Rahul Gandhi over 'vote theft' claims
'Told them to give it to me in writing': Raihan Vadra recounts how events unfolded before photos were taken down at Bikaner House exhibition
stories.summary: Raihan Vadra's photography exhibition, No Idea Is Fine, allegedly faced turmoil at Bikaner House when management objected hours before its start, claiming venue policy violations. While Vadra proposed removing select images, the officials demanded the removal of all 70 photographs, including those depicting the Indian national flag. This sparked outrage among Congress members, igniting debates about censorship and the value of artistic freedom.

stories.title: California geologist finds creek fossil using Google image search
State by state, some SIR hurdles are falling
stories.summary: States in India are currently reforming voter registration processes by allowing broader document categories for eligibility. Booth-level officers are actively visiting homes to assist voters left out during revisions. Many regions report that discrepancies are being resolved with less bureaucratic procedures. Voter engagement has improved significantly compared to previous years through various initiatives. The overall aim is to facilitate a smoother registration process for all eligible citizens.

stories.title: China's Bohai Bay oyster reefs show recovery, with 286 oysters per square metre
stories.summary: A study of oyster reef restoration in China's Bohai Bay has found encouraging signs of marine habitat recovery between 2022 and 2026. By March 2026, artificial reefs supported an average of 286 oysters per square metre, while suspended particles in the water had declined by approximately 62%. Published in Frontiers in Marine Science, the study also recorded an increase in seabed animals. However, researchers said further monitoring was needed to establish the project's long-term effectiveness.

stories.title: Mariska Hargitay helped fund testing of 11,341 rape kits in Detroit; 263 convictions followed
stories.summary: American actress Mariska Hargitay helped support a project to test 11,341 sexual assault evidence kits discovered in a Detroit police warehouse in 2009. The kits had remained untested for years, with cases dating back to 1984. Led by Wayne County Prosecutor Kym Worthy, the initiative had secured 263 convictions by April 2025, with investigations continuing across the United States.

stories.title: Lincoln’s 1864 signed photograph, found in an old desk, sells for $149,020
Pompeii’s grandest ancient residence gets €1.4 million restoration
stories.summary: Thanks to a private sponsor, the House of Marcus Fabius Rufus in Pompeii is set for restoration, with a portion expected to welcome guided groups by this Christmas. The renovation focuses on fresco restoration and improved visitor access, addressing the extensive damage the site suffered since its closure in 1980 due to a volcanic eruption.

stories.title: Scottish castle built in 1584 with original fireplaces and staircases listed for £120,000
stories.summary: Baltersan Castle, built in 1584 near Maybole, Ayrshire, is now available on the market for £120,000. This castle, which is roofless and Category A-listed, occupies 0.75 acres of land. Notable figures like Charles Rennie Mackintosh and poets Robert Burns and John Keats have been linked to the property. Although the building retains much of its original structure, planning consent for restoration has expired.

stories.title: EC announces bypoll for Madhya Pradesh Rajya Sabha seat vacated by L Murugan
‘Finding a place to belong’: Sonia Gandhi makes Instagram debut, shares first look of memoir
stories.summary: Sonia Gandhi has joined Instagram to share the first look of her upcoming memoir titled 'Belonging: A Journey of Love'. The memoir will be released internationally on November 10 and recounts her personal journey from Italy to India. It includes reflections on her relationship with Rajiv Gandhi and family tragedies. Due to a publishing dispute in India, HarperCollins India will now publish the domestic edition.

stories.title: Georgia woman sues over neighbour's marijuana smoke despite smoking ban; court dismisses claim
stories.summary: A Georgia woman sued after claiming her neighbour’s marijuana smoke repeatedly entered her apartment despite a no-smoking lease, affecting her breathing and health. Bridget Francis alleged that the apartment management ignored her complaints. However, on October 19, 2026, a Georgia appeals court upheld the dismissal of her claims against a California teachers’ pension fund, ruling that it was legally protected from the lawsuit.

stories.title: INDIA bloc huddle: Leaders to meet virtually on CEC row; SIR irregularities on agenda
stories.summary: INDIA bloc leaders, including Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge, will meet via video conferencing on Thursday. They will strategize regarding the Election Commission’s actions surrounding the electoral rolls. Opposition leaders have accused the Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar of irregularities and demanded his resignation. The bloc plans to continue its campaign against perceived threats to democratic institutions and has submitted a memorandum outlining its demands.

stories.title: California seventh-grader tests potential brain-injury treatment on 350 fruit flies
stories.summary: Alekha Goldberg from California has distinguished herself as a finalist in the 2026 Thermo Fisher Scientific Junior Innovators Challenge. Her innovative research focuses on the neuroprotective properties of methylene blue for traumatic brain injury, utilizing fruit flies in her experiments. The results show enhanced climbing ability and survival rates post-injury.

stories.title: Maldives sinks two retired aircraft to create an unusual underwater reef; coral restoration begins in 2026
stories.summary: Two decommissioned Dornier 228 aircraft are submerged near Kudagiri Island to create a diving attraction. Conservation teams are working to establish an artificial reef by attaching coral fragments to underwater frames. The project aims to combine marine tourism with aviation history while promoting coral growth. Various organizations are collaborating to monitor the ecological impact of this initiative.

stories.title: 'Stand for what's true': Priyanka Gandhi's emotional message for son Raihan after over 70 images removed from exhibition
Texas appeals court upholds $880 refund in rental deposit dispute
'India-based' D-Company tag: New Delhi rebukes UN rapporteur, flags 'glaring inaccuracies'
Emma Stone’s 1926 LA home sells for $4.3 million after renovation, $305,000 above asking price
stories.summary: Emma Stone has beautifully transformed a historic home in Los Angeles, which she bought for $2.3 million back in 2019. After completing significant renovations, she listed the property for $3.995 million in January 2024. Boasting a guesthouse, a larger kitchen, and preserved architectural features, the home quickly sold for $4.3 million just ten days later, showcasing Stone’s savvy real estate acumen.

stories.title: CJP leaders Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka summoned by Delhi Police day after release
‘Anti-Indian hate is exploding’: US lawmaker Raja Krishnamoorthi flags rising anti-Hindu hate online
US, Israel prepare for fresh Iran strikes as Tehran threatens with ‘Father of All Bombs’
stories.summary: The United States and Israel are preparing for potential military strikes against Iran after the upcoming midterm elections. Iran has announced it will reveal a new weapon called the 'Father of All Bombs' as tensions rise. US Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth met Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to discuss military options recently. Meanwhile, Iranian officials warn of severe responses if attacked, emphasizing improved missile capabilities.

stories.title: 'Successes in eliminating Maoism': PM Modi, EAM Jaishankar wish Amit Shah on birthday
'This evil man will be punished': Union minister Rijiju warns Delhi influencer over 'racial' abuse of Tripura youth
'Tricolor row': What happened at Priyanka Gandhi’s son Raihan’s exhibition at Bikaner House - controversy explained
Drones fall, strikes stall: How Musk's Starshield curbs hit Zelenskyy’s war against Russia
Kuwait-flagged tanker carrying 21 Indian seafarers hit by projectile in Strait of Hormuz; all safe
stories.summary: A Kuwait-flagged oil product tanker, M/T Al Dasma, was struck by an unidentified projectile in the Strait of Hormuz. All 21 Indian seafarers aboard the vessel were reported safe after the incident on October 21. This event follows previous attacks on vessels in the region, raising safety concerns for Indian mariners. The Indian government is in contact with ship management to ensure ongoing security measures.

stories.title: In Pakistan, Maldives President Mohamed Muizzu calls for early Saarc summit
stories.summary: The visit also saw the two sides signing 20 MoUs, including in areas like defence and maritime cooperation that will be of concern to India. This is not the first time though that Muizzu has called for revival of Saarc. In his independence day speech this year, Muizzu had also offered to act as a mediator between India and Pakistan to advance talks for an early leaders’ summit.

stories.title: British Indian stripped of OBE over rogue landlord allegations
stories.summary: Nirpal Singh Riat told TOI on Thursday that he disputes some of these allegations, which he says are “fabricated”. Regardless, a Hounslow councillor lobbied the honours forfeiture committee, which sits within the cabinet office, to get his honours withdrawn, he told TOI. Once notified, his lawyer wrote to the committee disputing the claims but never got a response.

stories.title: Congo Basin Journey: Ash Dykes loses contact for 16 hours; satellite link restores updates
stories.summary: Explorer Ash Dykes’ team raised concerns after losing contact with him for more than 16 hours during his 434-mile journey through the Congo Basin. The 35-year-old Welsh adventurer is travelling from Nola in the Central African Republic to Mossaka in the Republic of Congo. His team later re-established contact through a Garmin satellite device after Starlink and his power bank failed. Limited connectivity continues to restrict updates from the remote expedition.

stories.title: Texas Ranch State Park Purchase: Foundation buys 650 acres for new park; phased opening from 2027
stories.summary: The Texas Parks and Wildlife Foundation has acquired a family-run ranch in East Texas for future park development. This historic land, held by the Pollard family since 1940 and boasting valuable lakefront access, is set to transition to the Texas Parks and Wildlife Department by late 2027. The park will offer recreational opportunities while preserving the area’s ecological integrity, enabling the public to connect with nature.

stories.title: Subway co-founder’s relative buys Connecticut warehouse for $6.75 million, plans renovation
stories.summary: A member of the Buck family has purchased a Danbury warehouse previously owned by the Salame family. This transaction, completed for $6.75 million, signals a commitment to modernizing the site while preserving its industrial purpose. Plans include extensive renovations and the construction of an office building alongside the warehouse. The investment reflects confidence in the local economy and aims to maintain vibrant commercial use of the property.

stories.title: Why are uninsured vehicles not part of crash relief scheme? Supreme Court
stories.summary: Taking note that “Compensation to Victims (Interim Relief) Scheme, 2026” has not been notified or publicised, a bench of Justices JB Pardiwala and KV Viswanathan directed the govt to publicise it to ensure awareness. People must be made aware of their right to seek interim compensation, it said. Union road transport ministry officials said the scheme will be notified as provided for under Central Motor Vehicle Act.

stories.title: Rosatom completes supply of engineered safety features actuation systems for Kudankulam N-plant units 3 and 4
stories.summary: In total, about 300 items of equipment were manufactured and delivered to the plant – four sets of ESFAS CS in accordance with the number of safety instrumentation and control trains, per each power unit featuring VVER-1000 reactors. ESFAS is the system that monitors the process parameters of a power unit when there is a deviation from normal operation conditions.

stories.title: New norms for DL: Driving tutorial pass mark may rise to 75%, select licence services to be free
stories.summary: Under the proposal, the safe-driving tutorial would have to last at least 30 minutes. The higher qualifying score of 70% is aimed at making the assessment more stringent. The draft also proposes a defined procedure for online applications to change driving licence particulars, including name and address. Licencing authorities would have to approve or reject applications for changes within 15 days, giving reasons for rejection.

stories.title: Cincinnati’s vacant Terrace Plaza Hotel faces fresh redevelopment hurdles over tax dispute
stories.summary: Cincinnati's iconic Terrace Plaza Hotel has stood vacant since 2008, currently tied up in redevelopment plans. A contentious property tax valuation dispute between the owner and the city's school district has caused delays. This $160 million project seeks to honor the hotel's historical significance while also requiring a resolution of tax issues to proceed with construction, maintaining its vital role in the city’s architectural legacy.

stories.title: Sienna Miller’s £1.75m thatched cottage gets a £200k price cut
stories.summary: Sienna Miller's thatched cottage, known as Thatch, is currently listed for £1.75 million. The cottage, located in Buckinghamshire, offers a blend of historical charm and modern amenities. Originally purchased by Miller in 2008, it features four bedrooms and a stylish country kitchen. It embraces its 16th-century character while providing a peaceful rural lifestyle. The property is presented with a reduced asking price after being initially listed at £1.95 million.

stories.title: Cars to brake on their own: Centre plans AEBS mandate from Oct 2030
stories.summary: As for pre-2030 still-in production models, AEBS would mandatory from Oct 2032. The draft notification, with timelines for different ADAS safety features for cars, would be out soon, people aware of the development said, adding that focus would be more on taxis. They said the proposed timelines take into account the lead time that industry and users would need.

stories.title: SC stays probe against Vijayan & kin for a week to enable him to move high court
stories.summary: Referring to Section 175(4) of BNSS, which requires a report from the public servant’s superior officer before ordering an investigation into a complaint against the public servant for acts done in discharge of official duties, the bench said, “The single judge not only directed registration of FIR, which is the mandate in SC ruling in Vijay Madanlal case, but ordered commencement of investigation and submission of final report.”

stories.title: PM Modi has failed ‘abysmally’ on Manipur, says Congress chief Mallikarjun Kharge
stories.summary: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge asked Prime Minister Narendra Modi what has happened to the Peace Committee which was announced by home minister Amit Shah in June 2023 and what action has been taken on the Supreme Court-appointed Justice Gita Mittal Committee’s recommendations. He also asked what concrete measures have been taken to restore peace, protect citizens and address the continuing security challenges in the sensitive border state.

stories.title: Drug menace next target, says Union home minister Amit Shah; eyes 2029 deadline
stories.summary: Stating that an environment conducive to development has emerged in Kashmir, Northeast and LWE-hit regions, Shah particularly thanked CRPF and its CoBRA battalion as well as Chhattisgarh Police for their role in the decisive fight against LWE. The home ministry will dedicate the remaining part of 2026 and three years after that to freeing the country from the drug menace, Shah said.

stories.title: Tiger shooters got weapons via ‘dead drop’; couriers delivered guns a day earlier
stories.summary: Kunal, who has also been arrested, has emerged as a key character who had been in touch with gangsters Anil Pandit and Randeep Malik for over two months. He had also figured as the source of the weapon used for the murder of a forex-hawala trader in Sonipat last year, sources said.

stories.title: At Jamnagar refinery, Rubio and Ambanis discuss energy, digital infra, giga factories
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump had earlier announced the setting up of a $300 billion refinery in US, with RIL being part of his plank to revive industry in the country and bring back jobs that were offshored. The Mukesh Ambani-led company has, however, not outlined any details. The importance of Reliance has since increased because the Jamnagar complex is where hard Venezuelan crude can be refined.

stories.title: Delhi protests India’s internal matter, won’t comment: Rubio; calls UN experts an ‘oxymoron'
stories.summary: On Tuesday, more than 20 UN human rights experts in Geneva had expressed alarm over what they described as a “repeatedly heavy-handed police response” to peaceful youth-led demonstrations in the national capital. United States secretary of state Marco Rubio brushed aside criticism by “UN experts” of the Indian crackdown as he called them an “oxymoron”.

stories.title: NMC denotifies medical education rules; annual disclosures risk lacking verification
stories.summary: The 2019 Act also states that MARB may conduct evaluation of any institute at any time without prior notice. However, with the denotification, the aspects that need to be included in the evaluation report, such as verification of physical infrastructure, availability of the required number of faculty and review of feedback from students, have also been removed.

stories.title: Jeff Gordon’s foundation helped open Rwanda cancer centre; it treated 18,000+ patients by 2025
stories.summary: In 2012, Rwanda launched the Butaro Cancer Center of Excellence to fill the gap in cancer care services. Since then, it has treated over 18,000 individuals, greatly enhancing local healthcare. The center plays a crucial role by establishing vital diagnostic programs and training healthcare staff. However, challenges such as high drug costs and a lack of specialists remain, affecting survival rates.

stories.title: Florida homeowners sue HOA, alleging a $232,000 roof deposit was paid before the public vote
stories.summary: Homeowners in The Vistas at Phillips Commons have initiated a lawsuit against their homeowners association. They allege that a roofing contract worth $2.1 million was approved secretly before an official vote. The residents claim that a significant deposit was made before the meeting took place, indicating potential financial misconduct. An active criminal investigation is examining alleged irregularities involving both the association and the management company.

stories.title: India deal pretty close, will be different: Trump; pact to exclude unresolved sectors
stories.summary: There has been speculation in certain quarters that the much-awaited deal may not be comprehensive, covering all sectors, and the two sides may like to leave aside the issues which have been particularly nettlesome to have an understanding on those for which they have been able to hammer out agreements.

stories.title: Confidence in poll process key for democracy, halt list of candidates: SC to AP SEC
stories.summary: Senior advocate Maninder Singh, who appeared for YSRCP, said in 19 of the 100 urban local bodies — 13 municipal corporations and 87 municipalities/nagar panchayats — more than 63% of YSRCP candidates were prevented from filing nominations or their nomination papers were torn. Senior advocate Sidharth Luthra, for AP govt, said YSRCP was importing criminal elements from as far as Punjab and fomenting violence only to cry wolf later.

stories.title: RSS-affiliated labour organisation opens first Kashmir office in Pulwama
stories.summary: BMS has been actively working in Kashmir since 2020 after the abrogation of Article 370 and currently has 20 registered affiliated labour unions in the region, Khuchay said. Initially, there were a lot of misconceptions about RSS, he said. However, the BMS functionary claimed that over the years, he had succeeded in convincing the people that RSS was not anti-Muslim, but pro-labour and pro-people.

stories.title: Manhattan townhouse with 41-foot pool gets $1 million price cut
stories.summary: Nestled at 238 West 74th Street, this pristine townhouse dating back 140 years is available for $10.45 million. Spanning around 6,460 square feet, it boasts six bedrooms and six-and-a-half bathrooms. Unique features include a splendid 41-foot heated indoor pool and lush outdoor spaces, combining modern conveniences with historic charm. Its recent renovations enhance the classic aesthetics, and it has seen several price reductions from an initial $14.945 million.

stories.title: Connecticut tenant wins $1.6 million after fall, but landlord's appeal leaves him unpaid
stories.summary: Michael Criscuolo, a resident of Connecticut, faced a life-changing injury after stumbling over construction debris near his apartment. A court ruled in his favor, granting him $1.6 million due to the landlord's clear negligence. Yet, Sim Levenhartz has failed to pay the awarded sum, with an appeal still in progress, prolonging Criscuolo's wait for justice. Meanwhile, the property deteriorates further, racking up municipal fines.

stories.title: Drone-linked narco-terror module busted in Jammu; 804 gm heroin; 1.1 kg opium seized
stories.summary: “Preliminary investigation has indicated a cross-border nexus. Inquiry is underway to identify the source of the consignment, its intended recipients, and persons involved in the network,” police said. The network came to light during the questioning of a 26-year-old man arrested for consuming drugs in RS Pura on Wednesday. Police said, “The arrested man, Sunny Kumar, a resident of Kotli Mirdian, Suchetgarh, revealed about the smuggling module.”

stories.title: Who are the terrorists? J&K and Ladakh high court questions ‘vague’ detention order
stories.summary: A single bench of Justice Wasim Nargal said preventive detention, which allows authorities to deprive a person of liberty without a regular criminal trial, demands the “highest degree of constitutional responsibility and procedural diligence”. The court directed the DC to appear with the detention order, police dossier, material placed before him and records showing his consideration of the case and subjective satisfaction before ordering detention under PSA.

stories.title: Pennsylvania turned fire-damaged land bought for as little as 18 cents an acre into a million-tree park
stories.summary: Promised Land State Park in Pennsylvania originated from the acquisition of fire-damaged land between 1902 and 1904. Through dedicated efforts by the Civilian Conservation Corps, over a million trees were planted, transforming the landscape into a beautiful forested area. Recreation facilities were developed to enhance visitors' enjoyment, although the park faced hurdles like a tornado in 1998.

stories.title: Eva Marcille faces $22,000 HOA lawsuit over unpaid fees and property violations at her Georgia home
stories.summary: Eva Marcille, known for her reality TV fame, is embroiled in a legal battle with her Georgia homeowners association due to claims of unpaid dues and property upkeep issues. The association alleges that Eva has failed to respond to multiple warnings concerning her property's state. Her attorney, Michael T. Sterling, has pledged to vigorously defend her, underscoring potential ramifications for homeowner rights in Georgia.

stories.title: Congress pulls up SBI over data breach, seeks accountability; experts call leak 'no ordinary incident'
stories.summary: Congress has raised concerns regarding a significant data exposure involving 3,897 customer records from State Bank of India. The bank confirmed the leak following alerts from its cybersecurity providers and has since initiated an investigation. Experts warned that the leaked data may pose risks to national security due to the bank's prominence. Meanwhile, SBI assured that customer balances remain safe and are implementing security measures.

stories.title: 7,000 people from 126 districts once hit by Naxalism to attend Ekta Diwas parade in Kevadia
Ankita Bhandari case: CBI serves notice to actress Urmila Sanawar for narco test
'I'm killing this…': Kansas man arrested for threatening to shoot Donald Trump
‘Remain vigilant’: India urges citizens in France to avoid protest sites ahead of fresh demonstrations
stories.summary: The Indian Embassy in France has raised an alert for Indian nationals amid ongoing protests in the nation. Citizens are advised to avoid large gatherings and comply with directives from local officials. With violent outbreaks and curfews emerging in reaction to increasing living expenses, the French government braces for more unrest. Indians living in France should closely follow news updates and keep emergency contacts easily available.

stories.title: Trump's son 'opposed' Iran war, believed US should avoid another Middle East conflict
stories.summary: Donald Trump Jr expressed private opposition to the war with Iran, differing from his father's military approach. Despite sharing his views with close associates, he has avoided public disagreements with his father. The conflict has revealed divisions within the MAGA movement on foreign intervention. Domestic challenges, like rising fuel prices, have affected Trump's approval ratings amid the ongoing war.

stories.title: Man buys $30 drawing at estate sale, later linked to Renaissance master Dürer and valued at $10 million
stories.summary: A drawing bought for $30 at an estate sale in Massachusetts is confirmed to be by Albrecht Dürer. Experts attribute the ink sketch to 1503 and estimate its value between $10 million and $50 million. The anonymous buyer initially believed it to be a modern reproduction, showcasing his artistic instincts. Extensive analysis confirmed the drawing's authenticity and its links to Dürer’s other works.

stories.title: Hilary Duff’s $3.85M Beverly Hills home gets playful family makeover
India sees a drop in GHG emissions in 2025, even as UNEP flags huge gap in global reduction efforts
US top court nixes Trump admin's bid to restrict medical care for transgender inmates
52-acre California vineyard once part of Hollywood star Fred MacMurray’s ranch lists for $22 million
stories.summary: Part of Hollywood actor Fred MacMurray’s 1,750-acre California ranch, the 52-acre Flax Estate and Vineyard in Healdsburg has hit the market for $22 million. Owned by philanthropists Jeffrey and Laurie Ubben, who bought the property for $21 million in 2016, the estate features 26 acres of organically farmed Pinot Noir vineyards and three residences.

stories.title: Minnesota tribe reduces casino land request by nearly 75% after locals raise concerns
stories.summary: The White Earth Nation in Minnesota has reduced its proposed casino land-trust request from nearly 300 acres to 80 following concerns about drinking water, traffic, infrastructure costs, and property taxes. The project, planned for Clay County, has not yet received federal approval and also requires concurrence from Minnesota's governor. Tribal representatives say a decision could come by late 2028 under the most favourable circumstances.

stories.title: San Francisco co-op born after Black displacement gets $23 million boost for 2,400-home redevelopment
stories.summary: Freedom West Homes has acquired crucial funding to embark on an ambitious redevelopment initiative that will yield 2,400 new homes. This project prioritizes the needs of existing cooperative shareholders, ensuring they remain in place rather than face displacement. Notably, it focuses on replacing dilapidated structures while maintaining ownership for Black and immigrant families.

stories.title: Australia’s endangered palm cockatoos get artificial nests; first chick fledges in world-first
stories.summary: A palm cockatoo chick has recently fledged from an artificial hollow in the Cape York Peninsula, marking a positive step for conservationists. They installed 29 artificial nesting hollows to combat the lack of natural breeding sites. This first successful breeding event is a pivotal achievement in palm cockatoo conservation. Ongoing monitoring will assess how well these new hollows can facilitate nesting and chick growth for this endangered species.

stories.title: Rs 50k bond, no Jantar Mantar protest call: What are the conditions of CJP leaders' release
AAIB asks Alliance Air to ‘strengthen simulator training’ for pilots in serious incident probe report
stories.summary: The Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau has recommended enhanced simulator training for Alliance Air pilots after a serious incident. On October 8, 2024, an Alliance ATR undershot the runway at Bhubaneswar due to severe rain. Pilots struggled with communication and situational awareness, leading to complications during landing. The investigation noted contributing weather factors such as turbulence and low visibility.

stories.title: Glacier Cliffs Retreat And Stabilise: Study tracks rapid ice loss; long-term collapse less certain
stories.summary: Recent research reveals that Antarctica's glaciers are retreating at a faster pace than earlier predictions had estimated. By analyzing over 15,000 satellite images, scientists focused on the stability of ice cliffs. While some cliffs showed signs of quick retreat, they later stabilized instead of collapsing completely. Factors like water depth and the shape of the underlying bedrock significantly influence glacier stability.

stories.title: Rhode Island Home Price Cut: landmark Reading Room gets $1.2m trim; now listed at $9.75m
stories.summary: The Reading Room, a stunning waterfront residence dating back to 1880, is now available for $9.75 million, down from its original listing of $10.95 million. This beautifully restored Victorian property boasts incredible views of Narragansett Bay, allowing future owners to enjoy a unique slice of coastal heritage. Its charm and character make it an exceptional opportunity for buyers seeking a historic home.

stories.title: Tyler Perry cuts Wyoming mansion price by $3.5 million after $30 million Puerto Rico home purchase
stories.summary: Tyler Perry has reduced the asking price of his Wyoming mansion by $3.5 million, bringing it down to $36 million after reportedly buying a $30 million home in Puerto Rico. Built in 2019, the 37-acre estate features nine bedrooms, 8.5 bathrooms, a home theatre, a cowboy-themed bar, a swimming pool and a guesthouse.

stories.title: 'Shouldn't have come if unwell': Subodh Uniyal defends public reprimand of Daler Mehndi
Sacramento jury awards $33.3 million to physics student injured by a falling tree branch in 2020
stories.summary: In a landmark decision, a jury in Sacramento awarded Michael Flynn $33.3 million after he sustained a brain injury from a dead branch falling during his jog in McKinley Park. The city was found wholly negligent in their tree maintenance and safety checks. Despite the injury, Flynn persevered through rehabilitation to earn his doctorate in physics, advocating for greater accountability in public infrastructure safety.

stories.title: Kirsten Dunst’s former LA home sells for $4.55 million in just nine days
Louisiana’s historic Lincoln Theater set to reopen after years of restoration
In Southern California, five rival supercolonies of Argentine ants are engaged in a war that has led to 15 million deaths already
stories.summary: A tumultuous and deadly rivalry unfolds among five Argentine ant supercolonies in San Diego, resulting in an alarming number of fatalities. These strongly territorial ants engage in relentless battles, disregarding the 'dear enemy effect' common in territorial animals. Surprisingly, studies reveal that these colonies have reached an impasse, maintaining fixed borders even amid continuous aggression, indicating a lengthy conflict without an end in sight.

stories.title: 2 Indian-origin pharmacists jailed in UK over £1.3m NHS cancer drug fraud
I&B ministry warns TV channels over communal rhetoric, violent visuals, AI use
stories.summary: Advisory flags violations of Programme Code; asks broadcasters to curb inflammatory debates, strengthen editorial checks

stories.title: Reba McEntire-backed Texas charity has welcomed over 35,000 families since 1992
stories.summary: Established in 1992 by Reba McEntire, Reba's Ranch House serves as a sanctuary for families of hospitalized patients, having provided aid to over 35,000 families. The house offers not just accommodation and meals but also emotional and spiritual support through initiatives like Room for Hope. Many guests have experienced marked improvements in sleep and anxiety during their stay, reflecting the house's responsive growth to community needs.

stories.title: All India Kisan Sabha threatens govt of 'militant resistance' if it goes ahead with US trade deal
Dallas’ historic theater to relight its tower after $45 million redevelopment
stories.summary: On November 1, Dallas's iconic Forest Theater is poised to make its grand return following significant restoration efforts. With a staggering $45 million injection aimed at modernizing its cultural offerings, the reopening promises live performances and food vendors to engage the community. The relighting of the Tower and marquee heralds a rejuvenated era, fostering support for local artists and revitalizing the South Dallas cultural scene.

stories.title: Westminster Abbey Sarcophagus holds skeleton dating back to AD 987–1052
Evening news wrap: Court orders release of CJP leaders Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka; Delhi's AQI slips into 'poor category' & more
stories.summary: SEM orders release of CJP leaders Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka; Delhi's AQI slips into 'poor category' & more

stories.title: London residents may keep homes after 12-year fight against estate demolition
stories.summary: In a pivotal decision, Lambeth Council has announced plans to halt the demolition of the Central Hill and Cressingham Gardens housing estates. The focus will shift toward improving existing homes and fostering community ties, sparing residents from the threat of eviction. This significant turnaround, subject to Cabinet approval on October 21, marks a commitment to preserve community integrity and architectural character.

stories.title: Alabama farmer secretly paid strangers’ medicine bills for a decade before his death
Delhi court orders release of CJP leaders Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka
stories.summary: A special executive magistrate court in Delhi reserved its order regarding the custody of CJP leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka. The police sought an extension of three days for their custody following a protest at Jantar Mantar. During the proceedings, Das and Ranka challenged the custody extension in the Delhi high court. The high court advised them to await the SEM's decision before seeking further legal remedies.

stories.title: Kolkata stampede probe: SIT gets 3 months to uncover cause of tragedy
'Avoid airing anti-national content': Govt warns TV channels against inflammatory debates and AI misuse
Dragons’ Den investor called her idea “pathetic”; she built a £10 million firm
‘Next big challenge is drugs’: Amit Shah sets 2029 target after Naxalism crackdown
OpenAI to train government employees in AI through Mission Karmayogi platform
Delaware marked its state parks' 75th anniversary by planting its 75,000th tree, completing a five-year goal across 17 parks
stories.summary: Delaware celebrates the planting of its 75,000th tree in state parks, coinciding with the park system's 75th anniversary. This achievement contributes to a larger goal of planting one million trees by 2030. The initiative features diverse tree species, driven by the support of community volunteers. Notable trees like the American holly were chosen to improve environmental quality and provide inviting spaces for the public.

stories.title: Lonnie Mack’s iconic Flying V guitar and amplifier sell for $550,000 at auction
stories.summary: The legendary 1958 Gibson Flying V guitar, famously owned by Lonnie Mack and dubbed 'Number 7', fetched an impressive $550,000 at auction. This auction also featured Mack's 1962 Magnatone Custom 440 amplifier, which was crucial to his distinct sound. Mack's guitar, tailored for his innovative techniques, has had a profound influence on blues-rock music for many years.

stories.title: After son’s death, mother’s support group now helps 7,000 men weekly
Monsoon's gone, El Niño isn't: Why India's weather worries are far from over
stories.summary: El Niño is increasingly influencing global weather patterns including agriculture and temperatures in India. Current forecasts predict a warmer winter as El Niño intensifies, which could affect agriculture adversely. Recent monsoon rainfall deficits raise concerns regarding water resources and crop yields moving forward. Different regions may experience varying extremes from drought to flooding in the coming months due to this phenomenon.

stories.title: ‘I'm not a travel agent’: Shashi Tharoor when asked about Rahul Gandhi's foreign trip
Australia releases 50 critically endangered smoky mice into forest after decades of absence
stories.summary: Australia has successfully reintroduced almost 50 critically endangered smoky mice into South East Forest National Park. This reintroduction represents a significant step towards restoring the region’s ecosystem and native mammal populations. Various species, including the long-footed potoroo and eastern quoll, are also planned for reintroduction. The effort is part of a broader initiative by the NSW Government and conservationists.

stories.title: Dave Bautista borrowed money for Christmas gifts before WWE and Hollywood fame
Virginia is turning 100,000 tons of demolished bridge concrete into fish habitat; 951 tons already underwater
stories.summary: The Hampton Roads Bridge-Tunnel expansion project involves dismantling an old bridge and using the concrete for artificial reefs. This initiative helps divert demolition waste from landfills while enhancing underwater habitats. Approximately 100,000 tons of concrete is expected to be repurposed for marine life by 2027. The Virginia Marine Resources Commission manages the artificial reefs that support local fisheries and marine ecosystems. This innovative approach connects infrastructure development with environmental sustainability.

stories.title: Swiss brothers spend £10,000 creating a Greek village in their garden
Ukraine peace, prisoner release & Trump meeting: What was discussed in Putin's meeting with US envoy Witkoff
stories.summary: Vladimir Putin met with US special envoy Steve Witkoff to discuss potential solutions to the Ukraine conflict. Witkoff presented proposals aimed at reviving negotiations between Russia and Ukraine, emphasizing the need for trilateral talks. During the meeting, they addressed the release of Stephen Hubbard, an American prisoner in Russia, and issues related to economic cooperation.

stories.title: 'Forces working to destabilise India, have 3 core agendas': BJP blames oppn, draws Ravana comparison
‘Then, you are not Gen Z?’ Delhi High Court’s light-hearted exchange with CJP leaders; Dipke reacts
stories.summary: During a hearing, the Delhi High Court engaged in a light-hearted exchange about Generation Z with Cockroach Janta Party leaders. The court questioned the legal approach taken by the petitioners against the custody extension issued by a Special Executive Magistrate. Concerns were raised about possible violations of prohibitory orders related to protests as well. The petitioners ultimately withdrew their plea after expressing worries about the outcomes of their surety reconsideration.

stories.title: Boston school custodian donates kidney to save colleague’s brother
‘Mousetrap for billionaires’: OceanGate CEO Stockton Rush planned to die during Titanic wreck dive, longtime friend claims
Lake Moraine lowered for dam repairs 190 years after its constructio
Missouri Appeals Court rejects couple’s ownership claim to 40-foot road through neighbour’s land
stories.summary: In a notable case from Missouri, a couple gained legal rights to their isolated property via their neighbor's land. Although the court initially granted them ownership of the access road, it later corrected this decision. Ultimately, they received a permanent easement, illustrating the difference between property rights and ownership. The couple can access their property while the neighbor retains the land under the road.

stories.title: Nazi-looted Degas painting sparks $10.7 million inheritance battle decades later
Margot Robbie’s renovated Hollywood bungalow sold for $1.2 million
stories.summary: In February 2018, Margot Robbie bought a charming 945-square-foot bungalow in Hollywood Heights for $950,000. After giving it a stylish makeover, she rented it out at various rates. She eventually sold the property in 2021 for around $1.2 million, marking a profitable investment. This venture underscores the appeal of smaller homes in attractive neighborhoods, complementing her extensive property collection across Los Angeles and Australia.

stories.title: CJP's Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka withdraw plea challenging custody in Delhi HC
Meloni toughens protest laws: Teen detentions, parental liability, 5-year jail term
stories.summary: In response to recent disturbances, Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has introduced stringent security measures aimed at curbing protest-related violence. These measures entail prison sentences, fines, and even financial repercussions for parents of minors who participate in illegal protests. Authorities now have increased powers to detain youths perceived as threats, irrespective of actual criminal acts.

stories.title: Wetland restoration boosts Spain’s marbled ducks to 172 breeding females in 2025
Missouri court upholds revival of $220,000 judgment after appeal deadline is missed
stories.summary: Diane Longsdon encounters a significant legal hurdle as an appeals court dismisses her bid to contest a $220,000 repayment order. The issue originated from modifications to a family trust created by Violet M. Steinert and her spouse in 1994. Although Longsdon initially received money from these alterations, a court later upheld the original trust's validity.

stories.title: She revived her boyfriend twice after they were struck by lightning; a year later, they are married
stories.summary: During a hiking trip, Eva Broderick's quick thinking saved her boyfriend Nick's life after they were both struck by lightning. Stranded in an isolated area, they faced delays as rescuers searched for them without precise location data. After their recovery, Nick's heartfelt proposal led to their wedding nearly a year later in August. Eva's heroic actions highlight the life-saving potential of CPR knowledge in unpredictable outdoor situations.

stories.title: England rugby legend Lawrence Dallaglio’s World Cup medal sells for £54,000
stories.summary: An exciting auction spotlighted an array of sports memorabilia, notably sounding the sale of Lawrence Dallaglio's silver-gilt medal from the 2003 Rugby World Cup, fetching £54,000. Collectors clamored for not only this remarkable piece but also his British and Irish Lions cap. Further captivating bids were made on football items, including Eric Cantona's iconic shorts and a BBC World Cup table, showcasing the rising allure of sports collectibles.

stories.title: CMRL bribery case: SC stays probe against former Kerala CM Pinarayi Vijayan for a week
‘Term UN experts is oxymoron’: Rubio calls anti-EC protests ‘domestic political matter’
‘Get your facts straight’: BJP accuses Rahul Gandhi of hypocrisy over RSS remarks on women’s rights
stories.summary: Bharatiya Janata Party officials criticized Congress leader Rahul Gandhi for his recent statements about the RSS. They accused him of hypocrisy regarding women's respect based on his behavior towards women. BJP spokesperson CR Kesavan emphasized Gandhi's failure to address allegations against a Congress MP involved in harassment. Additionally, BJP MLA Ram Kadam challenged Gandhi's understanding of the RSS's women's wing.

stories.title: SC directs Andhra Pradesh poll panel to decide on extending nomination deadline by Thursday
'Damning photos': Opposition leaders question Hardeep Puri's alleged meeting with Jeffrey Epstein
stories.summary: Leaders from Congress, TMC, and NCP have voiced strong disapproval of Hardeep Singh Puri for his dealings with Jeffrey Epstein. Puri has contended that his interactions came during a professional delegation after his ambassadorial tenure. Critics are calling for clarification about the substance of these encounters, emphasizing their concerns over the ramifications of Puri's associations with someone linked to serious criminal charges.

stories.title: ‘Was it necessary?’ Anupam Kher slams Uttarakhand BJP minister over Daler Mehndi row
stories.summary: Anupam Kher expressed his disappointment with BJP's Uttarkhand minister Subodh Uniyal's treatment of singer Daler Mehndi on stage. During a cultural event, Uniyal called out Mehndi for allegedly lip-syncing and questioned his sobriety. Kher emphasised the importance of addressing concerns privately to maintain dignity and respect. Singer Mika Singh defended Mehndi, citing his health issues and denying alcohol consumption allegations.

stories.title: Kandinsky painting stolen by Nazis sells for $42M at auction
stories.summary: A painting by Wassily Kandinsky, titled Das bunte Leben, sold at auction for £31.56 million. This artwork was returned to the heirs of its original Jewish owners after decades of dispute. The piece was originally painted in 1907 and displayed at notable exhibitions. Following its theft by the Nazis, it changed hands multiple times before being held by a German bank.

stories.title: China’s vegetation restoration linked to groundwater drought from 2003 to 2015
stories.summary: Vegetation restoration on the Loess Plateau started in 1999, which caused a significant decline in groundwater storage levels. From 2003 to 2015, researchers observed rapid vegetation growth alongside worsening groundwater drought conditions. The decline in groundwater was statistically significant and affected a larger area with more severe drought. Satellite data provided insights into the relationship between vegetation growth and groundwater drought across the region.

stories.title: More trouble for CJP leaders: Another FIR against Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka transferred to Crime Branch
stories.summary: Delhi Police has transferred two FIRs against Cockroach Janta Party leaders to the Crime Branch for investigation. The leaders, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, were detained during protests at Connaught Place and Jantar Mantar. Legal challenges have been filed by their team to contest an extension of their judicial custody. They claim their continued detention violates their fundamental rights and due process.

stories.title: Queensland farmer reports cloudy well amid 96-million-litre water extraction plan
'Human rights shouldn't be used for political pressure': India amid UN criticism over handling of protests
After HM visit CBI team begins investigations into killing of anti-drug activist, CBI registers FIR
stories.summary: A team from the Central Bureau of Investigations arrived in Mansa to investigate the murder of Parwinder Singh Jhota. The investigation was prompted by demands from Jhota's father and a local action committee for justice. Union Home Minister Amit Shah visited the bereaved family and assured them of justice before the CBI's arrival. The CBI is expected to collect evidence pertinent to the case and conduct a thorough investigation.

stories.title: Dev Rai founded a nonprofit at 15; it has helped 400 artisans, sold 900 products and mobilised 300 volunteers
stories.summary: At just 15 years old, Dev Rai launched Serving Society Global Foundation, aiming to uplift India's traditional artisans. This growing nonprofit has generated over $15,000 and engaged more than 300 volunteers. By creating essential connections between artisans and American consumers through community initiatives, Rai envisions a future where these artisans can thrive through digital platforms, enhancing cultural heritage while empowering youth in entrepreneurship and leadership roles.

stories.title: Olivia Wilde sells Studio City home for $5.23M, nearly $700K below 2023 price
Quote of the day by Stephen Hawking: “We are just an advanced breed of monkeys on..."
Pete Davidson sells Staten Island condo at a $400,000 loss after listing in 2026
stories.summary: Pete Davidson sold his Staten Island condominium for $800,000, taking a substantial loss on the property. He had previously purchased the condo for $1.2 million and completed renovations after acquiring it. Davidson also struggles to sell his North Salem estate, which has undergone multiple price reductions since being listed. The estate features amenities such as a gourmet kitchen and a gaming room, appealing to potential buyers.

stories.title: Who is next Republican nominee for US Prez? Vance expects endorsement; Trump says 'no'
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump has declined to endorse Vice President JD Vance for the 2028 presidential election. While Vance expects Trump's support if he runs, Trump did not commit to backing him. Trump stated there are many capable individuals who could succeed him in the future. Vance acknowledged he hadn't discussed his candidacy directly with Trump. Both their remarks highlight the uncertain nature of the upcoming Republican nomination contest.

stories.title: When superheroes hit the streets: Batman, Spider-Man & Cap.America at France protests - watch
stories.summary: Recent protests in France saw participants dressed as superheroes like Captain America, Batman, and Spider-Man. While demonstrations began with student grievances, they broadened to include various groups united against rising living costs. In cities like Marseille and Paris, clashes with police erupted, where costumed figures captured attention amid the unrest. Additionally, historical figures such as Napoleon were also spotted among demonstrators.

stories.title: 'My journey began with Ramleela': Ravi Kishan portrays Lord Ram during Dussehra celebrations in Delhi
Jhota murder case: CBI takes over Punjab anti-drug activist killing case, files fresh FIR
stories.summary: The Central Bureau of Investigation has registered a case regarding the murder of Parvinder Singh Jhota. Jhota was shot dead inside a medical store in Punjab's Mansa while hosting a Facebook Live session. Following demands from his family, Chief Minister Bhagwant Singh Mann announced the case's transfer to the CBI. Union Home Minister Amit Shah welcomed this decision but criticized the state government for not addressing other drug-related cases.

stories.title: A newly built Nando’s drive-through in Australia sold for $5.845 million
stories.summary: A newly built Nando's drive-through site in Cranbourne North has been acquired for $5.845 million by a New South Wales investor. The development includes a dual-lane drive-through facility and is secured by a long-term lease with Nando's Australia, ensuring an anticipated annual net income of $319,035, alongside fixed rent hikes of 3%. The transaction indicates a rising trend in commercial property investments in Victoria, particularly from out-of-state buyers.

stories.title: 'Quiet, quiet, are you a sick person?' Trumps snaps at reporter at White House; watch
Jonathan Spano’s eyesight ended his Navy dream; he flew for ‘Top Gun: Maverick’
Falling water levels at Utah’s Great Salt Lake exposed mysterious circular mounds
stories.summary: Newly released satellite images reveal an array of circular mounds at Great Salt Lake, predominantly formed by freshwater springs, which significantly contribute 12% to the lake’s water levels. Researchers, during expeditions across the receding lakebed, confirmed this essential finding. The unique circular reeds at the mound centers highlight the presence of these freshwater sources, which could also aid in controlling dust emissions from exposed areas.

stories.title: Fairfield Home Listed For Sale: Mowry-Housley couple asks $2.69 million; Napa Valley farm dream drives move
stories.summary: Tamera Mowry-Housley and Adam Housley are making waves in real estate as they list their picturesque Fairfield, California home for $2.69 million. Having acquired a quaint Napa Valley estate that requires renovations, their vision focuses on sustainable living with an orchard and vineyard to nurture their children's outdoor adventures. This shift marks a profound transformation in their family lifestyle, moving from spacious interiors to embracing more land and nature.

stories.title: 1923 Hollywood villa linked to Valentino sells for $2.5M
stories.summary: The Hollywood home at 6823 Iris Circle sold for $2.5 million, exceeding its asking price by $205,000. Initially bought for $1.05 million in 2016, the house underwent extensive renovations highlighting its history and charm. The property, linked to Rudolph Valentino and Pola Negri, boasts original features alongside modern updates. Located in Whitley Heights, a historic district, the neighborhood is known for its celebrity inhabitants.

stories.title: Third-grader Kailyn Brown won $25,000 for her child-friendly injection patches
San Antonio Park Deal: City uses $10 million buy to stop 3,500 homes; plan shields Edwards Aquifer
stories.summary: In June 2016, San Antonio city officials approved the acquisition of 204 acres of the Classen-Steubing Ranch. This initiative aims to preserve the land essential for the Edwards Aquifer recharge zone. The planned park space balances conservation with recreational facilities like sports fields and trails. Acquisition funding primarily derives from Texas's voter-approved Edwards Aquifer protection program and city budgets.

stories.title: Delhi high court cites national security, junks CIC order to IAF on PMs’ foreign trips
stories.summary: Allowing a petition by the Central Public Information Officer of Directorate of Personal Services, Air Headquarters, Justice Amit Mahajan held the IAF was justified in denying access to the records under section 8 of RTI that exempts disclosure of information that could jeopardise national security or pose a risk to a person’s life and physical safety.

stories.title: India & United States to boost defence, energy ties, Marco Rubio says trade deal close
stories.summary: Rubio’s second visit to India comes against the backdrop of the US’s Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act, which is intended to penalise countries purchasing Russian oil, and Trump’s subsequent temporary suspension of related tariffs. India maintains that its oil procurement is essential not only for its own energy security but also for the stability of global markets. Rubio lauded the “substantial progress” made by India in diversifying its energy portfolio.

stories.title: Police lens on Lawrence Bishnoi’s aide Randeep Malik in Tiger Shroff shooting case
stories.summary: Anil Pandit Pandit and Shroff ’s shooter Rehan both reported to Malik and were considered “his men” till a few months ago, a source said. Rehan had been earlier tasked by Malik and Pandit with a shooting incident in Sonipat as well. “Rehan was shown the same ‘American dream’ that Malik had shown Pandit in the past,” a source said.

stories.title: Allahabad HC cites long trial, lets off offenders, SC slams ‘misplaced sympathy’
stories.summary: A bench of Justices J B Pardiwala and K Vinod Chandran said it was a case of misplaced sympathy. The trial court had awarded fiveyear jail terms to the two, but the HC released them on probation. SC said the case was “doomed from its inception insofar as justice delivery to the victim is concerned”.

stories.title: India, US ‘perfectly aligned’ on key issues: Marco Rubio; defends ties with Pakistan
stories.summary: Addressing a gathering of India Inc’s leading business figures, Rubio said the relationship between the two countries could help shape the future of the global economy, particularly as advances in artificial intelligence and quantum computing transform industries and societies. “I truly believe the relationship between US and India is defining, in many ways, in a positive way, what the 21st century can look like,” he said.

stories.title: In talks with Reliance to refine more Venezuelan oil: US secretary of state Marco Rubio
stories.summary: US secretary of state Marco Rubio is visiting Jamnagar Wednesday to tour the Reliance refinery and, in a lastminute change of schedule, is likely to spend the night there. He was earlier scheduled to leave around 9pm and return to Mumbai. In Jamnagar, he will have dinner with Mukesh Ambani at the Vantara centre. Rubio’s visit to Jamnagar comes within weeks of a vicious attack on Ambani by Elon Musk.

stories.title: Steve Buscemi returned to firefighting after 9/11 and backed a charity for his former colleagues
stories.summary: Steve Buscemi, who once served in the New York City Fire Department, stepped up to assist at Ground Zero in the wake of 9/11. This selfless act highlighted the emotional toll on first responders. He subsequently became involved with Friends of Firefighters, a nonprofit that offers crucial mental health support, not just for firefighters but also their families, ensuring privacy.

stories.title: ‘Identify and defeat forces against India’: PM Modi calls for unity during Vijayadashami celebrations
stories.summary: Drawing lessons from Lord Ram’s life, PM Modi stressed self-reliance. Despite the ocean separating him from Lanka, Lord Ram mobilised collective strength, brought together available resources and achieved what appeared impossible, he said. “We must not sit relying on others. We must recognise our own strength and we must have faith in our own resources,” the PM said, linking the message to the goals of ‘Atmanirbhar Bharat’ and ‘Viksit Bharat’.

stories.title: Indian-origin Uber driver father in NYC seeks help on GoFundMe for daughter's funeral after mother kills five-year-old: 'I lost my whole world'
A DB Cooper ransom bill found in 1980 sold for $134,200 at auction in 2026
stories.summary: A fragment of a D.B. Cooper hijacking banknote fetched an impressive $134,200 at a Dallas auction. This particular note was part of the $200,000 ransom paid to the infamous hijacker back in 1971. Interestingly, in 1980, a young boy came across a piece of this ransom money at Tena Bar, which was later confirmed as authentic by the FBI.

stories.title: 'As a second-generation Indian-American': 21-year-old Vasant Bhatt says he voted for Democrat Talarico in Texas election after being disgusted by MAGA racism
County Weighs Land Purchase: Sarasota County rejects 126-home deal; eyes conservation buy
stories.summary: In a unanimous decision, Sarasota County officials have turned down a settlement allowing residential development next to the Celery Fields. Instead, they are considering acquiring the 51-acre contested land for conservation. Following a lengthy legal dispute with D.R. Horton, the county sees this move as vital for improving stormwater management and protecting local wildlife habitats. However, the details of negotiations and funding remain unresolved, leaving the property’s future in limbo.

stories.title: Catherine Breed completes 900-mile California coast swim after 111 days
Vivek Ramaswamy called 'pathetic' after mother of his rival makes strange appeal: 'Don't vote for my daughter, she's a liar'
AAIB chief gets a year's extension as many key probes, including AI 171, on
stories.summary: People in the know say while the aviation ministry “keeps the aircraft accident investigating agency at an arm’s length and does not interfere in its working in any way,” it is taking steps to strengthen the AAIB. The bureau's lab has been recently upgraded and it now has the capability to download cockpit voice recorder and digital flight data recorder (black box) to know the conversation in the flight deck and the flight parameters till before an event being investigated.

stories.title: Two Andaman, one Chhattisgarh site added to Unesco World Heritage tentative list
stories.summary: India has added three sites to its tentative list for UNESCO World Heritage status, including the Karst-mud-volcano Complex. The sites are located in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and Chhattisgarh, and the Archaeological Survey of India played a crucial role. Inclusion on this list is necessary for future nominations to the UNESCO World Heritage List. Currently, India possesses 45 UNESCO World Heritage Sites, ranking sixth in the world.

stories.title: Florida appeals court rejects homeowners’ legal fee claim after Hurricane Ian insurance dispute
stories.summary: In a recent decision, a Florida appeals court determined that homeowners Susan Reed and Kent Lonngren are ineligible to collect legal fees from Citizens Property Insurance. The couple had contested repairs linked to Hurricane Ian's 2022 storm damage. The court concluded that Citizens had fulfilled its duties, even while the homeowners pursued legal action during the appraisal phase, indicating that Citizens acted in good faith throughout the claim.

stories.title: Beverly Hills mansion once owned by Warner Bros. co-founder Harry Warner finally sells for $27.25 million
stories.summary: A legendary mansion in Beverly Hills, originally built for Harry Warner, has changed hands for $27.25 million after an extended listing. Initially priced at nearly $40 million in 2016, the estate received extensive upgrades while maintaining its Old Hollywood charm. Featuring a guesthouse linked to Marilyn Monroe, this property has hosted myriad celebrations.

stories.title: Shinde calls INDIA bloc ‘ten-headed Ravana’, accuses Uddhav of ‘vote theft’
Green Card jobs: Food delivery company Instacart agrees to pay $5 million penalty for discriminating against Americans
stories.summary: Instacart Green Card Jobs: Department of Justice said its investigation revealed that Instacart asked US workers to physically mail their applications for PER jobs while for visa holders, electronic applications were accepted. DOJ concluded that it was a discrimination against US workers and creating a burden on them.

stories.title: California’s Irvine Lake will be drained for five years as crews repair its 93-year-old dam
stories.summary: This month, Irvine Lake will see a significant decrease in water levels as vital dam repairs begin. The planned drawdown will facilitate crucial construction activities, enhancing the dam's structural integrity as per regulatory requirements. Water managers are closely monitoring potential winter weather effects to ensure community safety, while conversations with environmental specialists are underway to safely relocate fish and address concerns from anglers.

stories.title: NC State researchers create laser antenna that boosts reception 2.5 times
Wall Street climbs as healthcare stocks hit record, oil prices ease
stories.summary: Wall Street's primary indices saw an uptick, primarily driven by healthcare stocks reaching all-time highs amid falling oil prices. Investors are scrutinizing corporate earnings, with increasing worries about artificial intelligence expenditure impacting market stability. Significant advances from companies like Eli Lilly and Equifax boosted overall market performance. Nevertheless, General Motors and Steel Dynamics struggled with elevated costs and missed profit expectations.

stories.title: Indian-origin lab owner charged in US over $66.2 million bogus Covid test claims: DOJ
Delhi BJP leader burns giant cockroach effigy; CJP founder responds with SRK’s 'Swades' song
stories.summary: During Dussehra celebrations in Delhi, a 30-foot cockroach effigy was burned alongside traditional effigies of Ravan. Organizers stated that the effigy symbolized filth and promoted cleanliness in line with health awareness initiatives. Leaders of the Cockroach Janta Party reacted sharply, suggesting the move provided them with free publicity. Delhi minister Kapil Mishra remarked that cockroaches symbolize chaos and filth, reflecting public sentiment.

stories.title: No double standards on terror, need unified action to dismantle its entire ecosystem: Rajnath at SCO
Danish man transforms suburban home into castle with towers and four-metre moat
Forgotten Victorian camera found in Oxfordshire loft sells for £18,000 for wildlife conservation
stories.summary: During a house clearance in Oxfordshire, a homeowner discovered a rare Victorian camera stored for nearly 30 years. The camera, made of mahogany and brass, was auctioned for £18,000 after receiving significant interest from collectors. Proceeds from the sale will be donated to wildlife conservation charities in memory of the seller's late father. The father was passionate about nature and photographed local wildlife during his lifetime.

stories.title: Mary Berry’s daughter Belles Berry’s £3.95 million Blenheim Farm mansion goes under offer
stories.summary: Mary Berry’s daughter, Belles Berry, has received an offer for her £3.95 million Oxfordshire mansion, Blenheim Farm. Built in 2020, the property spans 10 acres and offers over 4,000 sq ft of living space. The luxury estate features a swimming pool, tennis court, two kitchens, a games room and panoramic countryside views.

stories.title: 'Expect partners to show zero tolerance on terrorism': EAM thanks US for handing over Tahawwur Rana
'Enough drama': Prince Harry says he wants to reconcile with family after years of rift
stories.summary: Prince Harry recently opened up about the need for reconciliation with his family, sharing his personal experiences that resonate with many who struggle with familial conflicts. He conveyed his aspirations for nurturing better connections with his father, King Charles III, and brother, Prince William. Harry also reflected on the joyous moments of his children attending a British school, honoring his mother's legacy and embracing a new chapter of healing.

stories.title: 'Youth on streets are revolutionaries': Uddhav Thackeray calls for 'regime change'
stories.summary: During the vibrant Dussehra rally at Shivaji Park in Mumbai, Uddhav Thackeray rallied his supporters, highlighting the significance of youth activism in addressing the alleged electoral irregularities impacting the fresh electorate. He proclaimed that the saffron identity is a legacy of his party, urging a reformation in the political climate and the prominent display of the saffron flag, echoing the influence of Bal Thackeray in his passionate address.

stories.title: Former MIT scientist wins $6 million in sexual misconduct suit by younger female colleague, says predator tag damaged career while it was a consensual relationship
Trump admin revoked more than 300,000 visas since 2025, including 4,000 linked to birth tourism: Report
Identify, defeat forces against India: Modi calls for unity, self-reliance
stories.summary: PM urges parties, institutions to put nation first; says national self-respect and strength key to overcoming challenges

stories.title: Caretaker’s 22-year stay sparks ownership battle over Frederick McCubbin’s former home
stories.summary: Fontainebleau, a former residence of the renowned artist Frederick McCubbin, finds itself at the center of a contentious legal battle over its ownership. This neglected property is co-owned by five individuals, while Trevor Hoare, the caretaker for the past 22 years, seeks to claim adverse possession. With the Supreme Court mandating a site inspection due to significant deterioration, the case is poised for its next hearing in August 2026.

stories.title: Italian banker was 'dropped to his death by mistake' when thugs dangled him out of his office window 'only to threaten'
PM Modi invokes 'Ram Rajya', warns against people hurting India's image - top quotes from Dussehra event
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the Dussehra celebrations and highlighted the importance of public welfare. He emphasized the need for social justice and self-reliance as central to national development. Modi reminded attendees of the ideals of Lord Ram, focusing on justice and equal opportunities. He encouraged recognizing India's potential while serving the poor and marginalized. The Prime Minister referenced Vijayadashami as a celebration of the triumph of good over evil.

stories.title: Indian-origin couple sentenced in UK for Covid PPE fraud; millions spent on luxuries
stories.summary: Jogesh Bhandari was handed a sentence for deceiving companies with false promises of supplying personal protective equipment during the COVID-19 pandemic. His conning tactics included misappropriating payments meant for PPE to fund a luxurious lifestyle. In a related verdict, his wife, Meenakshi Bhandari, received a suspended sentence alongside community service due to her participation.

stories.title: Florida couple missed 66 mortgage payments; husband's legal challenge fails after 17 years
stories.summary: A Florida couple missed 66 monthly mortgage payments on their Naples property, triggering a foreclosure dispute that began in 2009. During the legal battle, Gregory Brian Myers agreed to deposit $5,000 monthly while appealing the foreclosure. He later sued U.S. Bank, alleging it had violated their agreement. On October 19, 2026, a federal appeals court upheld the dismissal of his lawsuit.

stories.title: Evening news wrap: Rubio calls India a refining superpower; Kharge to raise SIR, delimitation concerns with PM Modi & more
‘Doing a real disservice’: Annamalai backs CJP leaders, questions their continued custody
Air India Express flight suffers bird strike, lands safely in Bengaluru
stories.summary: An Air India Express flight en route from Bhogapuram to Bengaluru encountered a bird strike on Monday, yet all 148 passengers and crew emerged safely. Following the event, technical teams diligently inspected the aircraft, confirming it was in good condition for future flights. Notably, a comparable bird strike event affected an Emirates flight just days earlier on October 17.

stories.title: 65-year old swimmer killed in shark attack off South African coast; 2 beaches shut
stories.summary: Tragedy struck at Orient Beach in KuGompo City when 65-year-old open-water swimmer Janine Lochrenberg was fatally attacked by a shark. Despite the desperate efforts of fellow swimmers who rushed to assist her, she suffered life-threatening injuries to her arm and thigh, ultimately succumbing to her wounds. In response, local authorities promptly closed the beach and launched an investigation, as reports indicate a slight rise in shark attacks in recent years.

stories.title: Daniel Rotman built PrettyLitter into a brand valued at $1.4 billion before Mars’ buyout
'Nobody told me..that's very confusing': Indian man Kamlesh Shah charged with election fraud in US says he didn't know he was not supposed to vote
Georgia woman’s deed to stepson rescinded; appeals court upholds $57,600 award
stories.summary: In a complex property dispute, a woman in Georgia transferred her property interest to her stepson during a period of cognitive decline. Her guardian, suspecting exploitation and fraud, pursued legal action, leading to a jury decision that invalidated the transfer and awarded damages. The stepson contested this ruling, alleging jury misconduct. However, the appeals court decided to uphold the initial verdict, solidifying the guardian's victory.

stories.title: Keith Haring’s hidden 1979 mural resurfaces in a $25M New York loft
Barbara Hutton’s Rolls-Royce survived a prince’s fatal crash and sold for £166,750 in 2026
stories.summary: This remarkable 1933 Rolls-Royce Phantom II Continental was originally crafted as a luxurious present from Barbara Hutton to Prince Alexis Mdivani. Following a tragic accident that claimed the prince's life, the exquisite vehicle was returned to Hutton for repairs. It changed hands multiple times before making its way to the United States in the 1970s.

stories.title: After Sergey Brin divorce, Nicole Shanahan's former Malibu home rents for $175,000 a month
Australian lawmaker Helen Haines loses leg after being hit twice by car: Report
stories.summary: Independent lawmaker Helen Haines was gravely injured when a man reportedly collided with her vehicle. This alarming event unfolded outside her office in Wangaratta, Victoria, as she was loading items from her car. Eyewitnesses claim the driver intentionally hit her car twice before escaping. A brave bystander managed to restrain the driver until the police arrived and took him into custody.

stories.title: 1867 gold coin found in Texas closet sells for $97,600 after 159 years in a family’s possession
stories.summary: A remarkable 1867-S Liberty Half Eagle gold coin was unearthed from an obscure closet in Texas, boasting a staggering value of $97,600. This highly sought-after coin, a valuable heirloom of a Union soldier, shattered previous auction records. Experts praised its rarity and condition, sparking intense competition among collectors. After a thrilling auction, the coin found its new home in a private collection, bringing its extraordinary journey to a close.

stories.title: Amit Shah meets families of anti-drug campaigners killed in Punjab; targets AAP on open drug trade
stories.summary: Amit Shah visited families of drug-related victims in Punjab, expressing condolences and discussing safety issues. He criticised the AAP government for its failure to tackle the drug menace effectively. Shah highlighted the dangers faced by those who oppose drug trafficking in the state. The recent murder of anti-drug activist Parvinder Singh Jhota escalated political tensions in Punjab.

stories.title: Qing dynasty bowl with bats and peaches sells for $2.048 million after 87 years in a Chicago museum
stories.summary: A stunning porcelain bowl from the Qing dynasty recently fetched $2.048 million at a Christie's auction. Crafted during Emperor Yongzheng's reign, the bowl is adorned with auspicious symbols, hinting it was a birthday gift for the emperor. After decades in the Art Institute of Chicago, the proceeds will fund new acquisitions and conservation efforts. This sale is part of a lucrative two-day auction dedicated to Chinese art.

stories.title: UK football club boss faces £100k legal battle over 24ft garden room built in 2018
stories.summary: A UK football club official is facing a court battle with his upstairs neighbour over a 24ft garden room built in 2018 with a bar, television and electric doorbell. Justin Salmon altered the structure after a tribunal found it breached his lease, but neighbour Andrianna Neophytou says the changes are insufficient and wants it demolished. Legal costs could exceed £100,000.

stories.title: Toledo’s 1897 swing bridge gets $65M upgrade to carry 286,000-pound railcars
stories.summary: In 2029, a comprehensive renovation of the Toledo Swing Bridge is set to begin, aimed at boosting freight operations. Key structural enhancements will enable the bridge to support heavier railcars, thereby improving efficiency in transportation. The project, backed by substantial federal funding alongside contributions from Wheeling & Lake Erie Railway, underscores a dedication to bettering rail infrastructure and strengthening ties with local port facilities.

stories.title: ‘Felt very happy’: Annamalai welcomes Bhagwat's remarks on Muslims' place in India
stories.summary: K Annamalai lauded Mohan Bhagwat's recent statements on the significance of religious inclusivity in India. Speaking at a Faith Leaders Conference in New York, Bhagwat encouraged the embrace of diverse communities, including Muslims, reiterating the value of dignity for all. Annamalai pointed out the rising global fascination with Indian civilization, stressing the necessity for leaders and citizens to embody the nation's established ideals.

stories.title: ‘Deeply regrettable’: Sanjay Raut’s Albania arson post draws flak from party colleague, others
BJP’s delimitation gambit: Will it isolate Congress, puncture opposition’s SIR unity?
stories.summary: As the government gears up for a new delimitation effort, Congress’s quest for opposition unity faces hurdles. Congress chief Mallikarjun Kharge raised alarms about the government's legislative strategies pertaining to delimitation and reservations for women. With Kiren Rijiju hinting at discussions across various opposition factions that may favor the bills, the scenario presents a complex web of political dynamics.

stories.title: 'They chose Canada': Alberta rejects separation bid in win for Carney
Oregon backyard railway grows into 32-mile miniature railroad across 2,200 acres
No hacker, no warning: How AI agents can enter business systems without anyone noticing
stories.summary: CERT-In says AI agents accessed confidential records on live systems of Indian organisations during testing, raising questions about how companies can protect their data and who is responsible for unauthorised access.
